༄༅// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab glegs bam bzhi pa las kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rgyud don gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma dang*// khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad shākya'i mgon// dpal ldan gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin rnams la// spyi bor thal sbyar gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan ngan song kun sbyong rgyud kyi don// mtshan mo'i padma bzhin du zum gyur pa// bla ma'i man ngag nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// phye las cho ga'i phreng mdzes btu bar bya// de la 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi lag tu blang ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ston par 'dod pas/ 'di la spyi don gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ de nas des las su bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ ras bris la brten te bsnyen pa'o// dang po dpa' bo gcig pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgom pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin pas/ de brjod par bya'o// de yang dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi gtso bo'i bsnyen pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen pa'o// de gnyis ka'i skyed pa'i cho ga ni/ dngos gzhi rang rang gi gtso bo'i sa bon dang*/ mtshan ma las rang rang gi gtso bo'i skur sgom pa'am/ hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa'i bag tsam de ma yin pa gzhan thams cad ni 'dra'o// de la rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas// thams cad zos te kun byas kyang*// 'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na// snying rjer ldan pa smos ci dgos// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor kun tu 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i skyed chog brjod par bya'o// de brjod pa/

'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi// bdag bsrungs la sogs byas nas kyang*// bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing*// zhes 'byung bas/ thog mar bsrung ba bya ste/ thog mar chos bdag med pa dang*/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po dang*/ de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas de'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ rang phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin par bsams la/ de'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ bdag nyid 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang*/ mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs byas pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ rgyu ma dang*/ mgo thod shas gang ba phyag na bsnams par bsams la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur byas la/ mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas/ mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas la/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha a na lārka/ mahā badzra krodha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba/ bi dra ba/ sarba a pā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra pra ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung*/ lan gsum gyis gnas bsrung*/ lan gsum gyis rnal 'byor bsrungs la/ rgyas par byed na/ khro bo'i bstod pa yang bya'o// de nas 'khor los sgyur ba nas 'byung ba bzhin/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang*/ a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis ka'i thal mo gnyis la/ a la sogs pa dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug gis gang zhing*/ 'od zer 'phro bar bya ste/ mthe bo gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba dang*/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐/

gung mo gnyis la trām̐/ srin lag gnyis la hrīḥ mthe'u chung gnyis la aḥbazhag la/ de ltar yi ge rnams bzhag par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang*/ bdag dang rjes su mthun par dran par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pas sa bon las/ g.yas pa'i mthe bo la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bo la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung ma la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams phan tshun lha dang lha mo'i khyad par ma yin pa/ sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa rigs lnga bzhin bsams la/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarb+ba dharm+māḥ zhes pas/ lha dang lha mo'i phan tshun reg par sgom/ rdo rje thal mo dang*/ spha ra spha ra a nu pra biṣṭa sarb+ba dharm+mā zhes pas rjes su zhugs par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang*/ a tyanta a nu pra biṣṭa sarb+ba dharm+mā badzra adzdza li/ zhes pas gnyis su med par ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ sems 'od gsal bar bsgoms la/ badzra bandha tra ṭa/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum dris bas sdig pa thams cad dral bar bsam/ badzra ā be sha/ zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug pa bcings la/ aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes lan mang du zlos shing rang gi snying gar dang po'i rdo rje'i rnam pa char bab pa bzhin du/ ye shes pa dbab pa dang*/ de brtan par bya ste/ tiṣṭha badzra dṛ ḍho me bha wa shā shwa to me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣṭa sarb+ba siddhi mi/ pra yatstsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho zhes brjod la sngar gyi phyag rgya dgrol/ yang badzra muṣṭiḥ zhes pas rdo rje bsdams pa mthe bo nang du bcug pa/

mthe bo'i rgyab tu mdzub mos bkab pa nang du bcug la/ oṃ badzra muṣṭi baṃ/ zhes pas/ phyag rgya bkrol te/ se gol gtogs la brtan par bya'o// de nas tshe dpag tu med pa nas 'byung ba'i chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ sems kyis bsgom par byas nas kyang*// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam// rang gi sa bon de dbus su// bsams nas dam tshig phyag rgya dag /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du// sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya// lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur// de nas rang gi sa bon dang*// phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlab// lta 'og go rim ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// zhes bya ba'i don bsgom par bstan pa ni/ ye shes phab cing brtan par byas pa'i rjes la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥdharm+māḥswa bhā wa shu ddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsams la/ de'i ngang las paṃ las padma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sa bon las rang rang gi gtso bo bskyed pa yin yang*/ 'gal ba med mod kyi/ 'dir kun tu 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed par bya ste/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dka' po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar stod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas dril bu'i kha dkur brtan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlab// ces pas byin gyis brlab ste/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin// mnyam par gzhag pas dpral bar ni// phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar// sangs rgyas bde gshegs bskyed rnams kyis// phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad// rnal 'byor rig pas mgrin phyogs su// thal mo snyim par sbyar ba ni// rtag tu padma'i rigs nyid kyis// padma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad// rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang*// snying gar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba// rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya 'di// dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o// phyag rgya dang po dpral bar bzhag la/

oṃ bhri ta bhri ta sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gnyis pa mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gsum pa snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ tshindha tshindha sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ lta 'og go rim ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ phyag na rdo rje las 'byung ba/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥzhes pa dang*/ de dag gi phyag rgya shākya thub nas 'byung ba/ rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs la/ mthe bo dang*/ mthe'u chung brkyang pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje yi'o// de nyid las mthe bo dang mthe'u chung de bzhin du byas la/ mdzub mo dang*/ srin lag padma 'dra bar bya ba ni sbyong ba'i rgyal po yi'o// de nyid las/ mdzub mo gnyis rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'o// mthe bo dang*/ mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba ni/ sdig pa thams cad sreg pa'i phyag rgya'o// lag pa g.yon pa de bzhin du bsgyur ba ni/ las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya'o zhes 'byung bas/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang po spyi bor bzhag la/ spyi bor mi bskyod pa bsam par bya'o// sngags dang phyag rgya gnyis pa gnyis kyis dpral bar reg pas/ dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ sngags dang phyag rgya gsum pa gnyis kyis rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du rin 'byung*/ sngags dang phyag rgya bzhi pa gnyis kyis lhag par 'od dpag med/ sngags dang phyag rgya lnga pa gnyis kyis rna ba g.yon pa'i steng du don grub bsam mo// rang gi rigs de bzhin gshegs pa yin na/ spyi bor rnam snang bskyed do// de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/

rang rang gi gtso bor bskyed nas/ gleng gzhi nas 'byung ba bzhin bsams te/ tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs nas/ de nas ngan song gi rgyud yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'od zer 'phro ba dang sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ de stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag kun tu snang bar byas so// kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas/ yang dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mchod de/ lan brgya stong du bskor ba byas te/ mgo bos lan brgya stong du phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de/ 'di skad ces gsol to// e ma'o sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod par bsam mo// 'gro ba de rnams kyis bdag la mchod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod par bsam mo// de nas ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ bdag gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rtsa rig bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros pas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas/ yang rang gi snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ yang sngar bzhin bsams la/ rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas par bya'o// thun mtshams su yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ bdag nyid la mchod pa dang*/

bstod pa bya ste/ smon lam btab la/ gtor ma dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ sātstsha la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba bya'o// dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa'o// bsdus pa bstan zin to// yang dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa byed par 'dod na/ kun rig las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems// bla na med par rtogs gyur pa'i// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang*// der ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs// zhes pa'i rjes la/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa zhes pas nang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan la/ yang ras bris kyi skabs nas kyang*/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la/ zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor sgom pa zin no// de la rgyud 'di nas/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis 'byung ba las/ 'dir kun rig la sbyar te brjod par bya'o// de yang ya tha bdag bsrung gnas bsrung nas bzung ste/ ngan song gi rgyud bkrol te ched du brjod pa yan chad ni/ sngar dang 'dra ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad ni gang du bskyed kyang 'dra'o// de ltar ched du brjod pa'i rjes la/ oṃ sha zhes pa dang*/ sha'i sgras shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ mi dmigs par stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las oṃ bha zhes brjod pas/ 'byung ba rim brtseg gzhal yas khang dang khor yug dang bcas gdan dang bcas pa rab tu mdzes shing rdzogs pa gsal bar bsams la/ de'i dbus su gdan dbus ma'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du rtsa ba'i rig pa'i nang du/ kun rig gi bskyed sngags/ oṃ sarb+ba bid sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yid kyis bkod la/ de rnams las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/ snang bar byas nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi chos kyi yi ge de nyid la zhugs par gyur to// zhes gsungs so// de nas tshur 'dus te dbus kyi snying po la thim pas gtso bo'i skur gyur nas/ sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa seng ge'i gdan gyi steng na/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i kun rig gi nga rgyal du byas la/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su 'khor gang bskyed kyi snying po bsam/ mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsams la/ de gnyis las 'od zer phar 'phros/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byas nas/ tshur 'dus te/ lha gang bskyed kyi snying po la thim pas/ rang rang gi skur gyur nas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bton te/ rang rang gi gnas su dgod do// de ltar re mos kyis dgod par bya'o// de dag gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du 'byin pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dgod pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i sngags la nang gi lnga ni kun rig las 'byung ba ni/ oṃ sarb+ba bid hūm̐/ mdun du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarb+ba bid phaṭa/ g.yas su rgyal mchog dkar po ting nge 'dzin gyis bzhugs pa'am/ yang na sngon po g.yon ting nge 'dzin/ g.yas mchog sbyin pa'o// oṃ sarb+ba bid aḥ rgyab tu shākya thub pa ser po chos 'chad kyis bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarb+ba bid tra tha/ byang du rin chen me tog sku mdog ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyis bzhugs pa'o// lha mo bzhi bskyed pa ni/ sngar 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin te/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ne hūm̐/ mer spyan ma dkar mo spyan 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra mā ma kī trām̐/ srin por mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra paṇḍa rī de hi de hi siddhi bo dhi lo kotta riṃ ba swā hā/

rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo padma 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra tā re tu ttā re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swā hā/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang gu utpa la 'dzin pa'o// kun kyang phyag g.yon pa ni gdan la brten pa'o// de'i phyi rol rtsibs bcu drug la sems dpa' bcu drug ste/ hūm̐ dzaḥhoḥdhu/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rgyal po/ chags pa dang*/ legs pa bzhi shar du/ trām̐ rya bhri ha/ rin chen gzi brjid/ rgyal mtshan/ bzhad pa bzhi lho ru/ hrī dhīḥkruṃ bha/ rdo rje chos/ rnon po/ rgyu/ smra ba bzhi nub tu/ kam̐ ram̐ kṣam̐ sam̐/ las/ srung ba/ gnod sbyin/ khu tshur bzhi byang gi rtsibs la'o// hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.aḥlas me'i mtshams nas bzung ste/ sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi/ yang hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ'am/ yang na shāka thub nas bshad pa'i sngags kyis/ bdug pa ma la sogs pa bzhi sngar gyi phyi rol du bsam/ shāka thub nas bshad pa'i sngags sam/ 'di nyid nas bshad pa'i dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥyis sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi bskyed/ de ltar rtsa ba'i lha so bdun ni ci nas kyang sgom mo// sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni/ rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o// de nas phyi rol gyi lha rnams sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ ma bsgoms kyang btub gsung*/ ting nge 'dzin la sgom snying 'dod rung*/ rdul tshon la bkod kyang rung ste/ bskyed pa'i sngags ni rtsa ba'i rig pas bskyed do// de yang rgyas par byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams nas bzung ste/ lha re la sngags re bya/ 'bring du byed na/ phyogs kyi grangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bzhi/ nyan thos rnams la bzhi/ de bzhin du rang rgyal ba la sogs pa la bzhi bzhis bskyed par bya'o// bsdu par byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gcig rang rgyal rnams la gcig gis/ nyan thos rnams la gcig gis/ phyi'i sgo ba khro bo la sogs pa la gcig gis/ phyi'i khor yug gi 'jig rten pa rnams sngags tshar bzhi'am/

brgyad kyis bskyed do// de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ bri ba'i skabs nas 'byung ba de 'dir yang sbyar te/ kun rig las/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor// mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te// zhes pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bha ga wān/ e hye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ shya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes pas/ nam mkha'i phyogs su spyan drangs la/ dngos su 'byor ba'am/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ci 'byor gyis mchod la/ yang kun rig las/ lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang*// gsang ba'i bcing bas bcings nas ni// mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya// zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang*// de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya// mtheb gnyis nang du gcugs nas kyang*// bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba bzhin/ ye shes pa bdag la bstim la/ de nas gong du bshad pa bzhin/ lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ gong du bstan pa bzhin rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la spyir bstan no// de nas lha so so'i sngags zlos shing*/ rang rang gi phyag rgya 'og tu bri ba'i skabs su 'chad pa bzhin du bstan par bya'o// de nas dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang zhing byin gyis brlab/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bdag la mchod/ bstod pa gang yang rung bas bdag nyid la bstod la/ skabs 'dir gtor ma gtang bar bya/ zhes gsung na/ gtor ma ni bzlas pa rdzogs nas btang na rjes su mthun no// de nas ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du sngags bkod nas/ bzlas pa ni lugs gnyis te/ rtsa rig dang lha thams cad kyi sngags dril nas/

phreng sngags su bzlas pa dang*/ yang na re mos kyis bzlas pa gnyis so// dril nas zlos na/ gtso bo dang lha kun gyi thugs kar zla ba la rtsa rig dang*/ sngags tshar ba bkod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi sngags tshar bar bzlas so// de'i dus su rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ rtsa ba'i rig pa dang*/ lha kun gyi sngags bzlas pa 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang*/ sngags kyi sgra byung bar bsam zhing bzlas pas/ thugs ka'i rtsa rig dang sngags rnams las 'od zer 'phros te/ de yang phyag na rdo rje las/ ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang byol song rnams su skyes pa'i sems can rnams bkrol bar bdag nyid kyis rab tu shes par bya'o// 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang bar byas te/ snang bar byas nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas/ chos kyi yi ge de nyid du zhugs so// zhes 'byung ba bzhin du bsam mo// re mos kyis zlos na/ thugs ka'i zla ba'i rtsa rig dang*/ gtso bo rang gi sngags bkod la/ bsam pa sngar bzhin bsam zhing bzlas so// de ltar gtso bo la ci nus pa bzlas nas/ 'khor gyi bzlas pa byed tsam na/ lha de dag rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la/ rang rang gi sngags dang*/ rtsa rig sngar bzhin bsams la/ de dag la dmigs la/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin bzhin bsam zhing bzlas so// de ltar thun dang po bsgoms la/ de nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ mchod pa lnga dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod la/ thun gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa la bsgoms pa'i lha nang du bzhag ste/ bdag mar me gcig las gnyis su chad pa ltar/ gtso bo las bye la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du mdo klog pa dang*/ sātstsha la sogs pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// de nas nang du zhugs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med par bsgoms la/ mchod pa nas bzlas pa'i bar du bya'o// thun tha ma la yang yi ge brgya pa brjod de brtan par bya/

mchod pa lnga dang*/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod la bzod par gsol te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub rtsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa rnams bdag la bsdus te/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la nyal ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam gzhan mdo klog pa dang*/ chos nyan bshad dang*/ sātstsha la sogs pa rnams bya'o// dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom pa'i bsnyen pa bstan zin to// bsnyen pa rgyas pa rdzogs so// //gsum pa ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ kun rig las/ ras la bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa de bzhin du bris la/ zhes bya ba nas/ de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po nyid thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa nyid bri'o zhes bya'i bar gyis bri ba bstan la/ de nas ri mo'i gzugs de mngon par mchod de/ zhes bya ba nas/ de nas gzugs de byin gyis brlabs te/ zhes bya ba'i bar gyis de'i rab gnas bstan la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs la// ci bdog pas ni mchod par bya// zhes pas de la mchod la/ de'i drung du bdag dpa' bo gcig pa'am/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gang mos pa gcig bsgoms la/ bzlas pa byas na 'grub par bstan te/ de yang de las/ rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang*// 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis// bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas kyang*// bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing*// 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du// bsnyen pa dag ni bya ba dang*// zhes bsnyen pa dang*/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni// brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya// sngags ni 'gal 'khrul med par bzlas// zhes nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ de nas bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni// dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la// mchod pa rgya chen byas nas kyang*// mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas par bya// ji ste gtso bo'am de yis sras// yang na lha rnams mthong gyur na// bsod nams snod las ci dga' bar// dngos grub mchog ni gsol bar bya// lha yi dngos grub 'bras bu ni// de la rtag tu dgyes nas stsol// zhes sgrub pa gsungs pa bzhin du sgrub bo//

//dkyil 'khor bri ba grub na/ gong du bstan pa'i ras bris de'i drung du tshe ldan dang*/ tshe 'das pa'i don la sogs pa thams cad bya bar nus so zhes gsung ngo*// ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa bstan zin to// //de ltar bsnyen pa gsum po gang yang rung ba gcig sngon du song bas/ de nas rang dang gzhan gyi don rnams byed par nus so zhes gsung ngo*// bsnyen pa thams cad bstan zin to// //spyi don gnyis pa de nas las su bya ba ni gnyis te/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don no// dang po ni bsnyen pa dang mthun par bzlas sgom rgyun du byed pas sgrub pa dang*/ rgyud nas 'byung ba'i ras bris la sogs pa bzhin/ dngos grub kyi ye shes la brten te/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa ste/ de ni rgyud kyi steng du zhib par rtogs par bya ste/ 'dir re zhig brjod par mi bya'o// gzhan gyi don la gnyis/ tshe dang ldan pa'i don bya ba dang*/ tshe 'das pa'i don bya ba'o// dang po tshe ldan gyi khyad par gyi chos ni/ dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa yin gyi/ gnyis pa tshe 'das kyi khyad par gyi chos ni/ ro la bya ba bsreg pa dang*/ mchod rten du gzhug pa dang*/ khang par gzhug pa gsum dang*/ rus bu'i sātstsha dang*/ phyir zlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba rnams yin zhing*/ lhag ma dbang bskur ba la sogs pa rnams la ni/ gnyis ka'i phyogs la khyad par ci yang med de/ de yang kun rig gi gson po'i dbang gi rjes la/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni// snga ma bzhin du bum pa la// brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni// dbang bskur bar ni rab tu brtag /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ gang gi don du sbyar nas bshad kyang btub mod kyis kyang*/ re zhig tshe 'das kyi don la sbyar te bshad parabya'o// de la bsnyen pa sngon du song bas las su bya ba ni bdun te/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/

bzlas pas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ phyir zlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gis sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ mchod rten btab pas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ thams cad la thun mong du ro la sogs pa'i rten med na ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dbang bskur bas sbyang*/ dbang bskur te mchod rten du bzhag nas sbyang*/ dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang khang du bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba'o// de dag la gtso bo ni dbang bskur ba yin la/ gzhan rnams so sor nyams su blang du btub kyang*/ dbang dang kun 'brel nas/ byar 'dod pas de brjod par bya'o// de la gnyis/ slob dpon gyis khyad par du las su bya ba dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bsdus te bya ba dang*/ rgyas par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bri bar ma nus na/ tshe dpag med kyi sbyin sreg gi skabs nas/ gtso bo ri mo lugs ma ru// rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces 'byung bas/ bris sku'am/ lugs ma'i drung du/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rgyas par bshams la/ de'i drung du sdig pa sbyang ba'i rten ro la sogs pa 'jog pa'i stegs bu khru gang pa la/ padma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sngon po la gong ras la sogs pa gzhan ci mdzes su bris pa'am/ de ma grub na maṇḍal tsam yang rung ste/ de'i steng du rten bzhag la/ bdag bsnyen pa bzhin/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor rdzogs nas/ ras bris la sogs pa la ye shes sems dpa' rgyas bsdus gang rung gis spyan drangs pa de la/ rgyas bsdus ci 'byor pas mchod la/ gtor ma btang ste/ 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bdag 'jug ni/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa blangs pa la bsdus la/ slob ma la bya ba dbang bskur bas sdig pa sbyang ba nas bzung ste/ sātstsha'i bar thams cad 'dir bya bar nus so// slob dpon gyi khyad par du bya ba bsdus pa bstan zin to// da ni slob dpon gyi khyad par bya ba rgyas pa bshad par bya ba la chos bcu ste/

bsnyen pa sngon du bya ba dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ shugs las 'byung ba sta gon byas kyang 'gal ba med pa dang*/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i rten dgod pa dang*/ rgyan dgram pa dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ lha sgrub pa dang*/ mchod cing gtor ma bya ba dang*/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa'o// de la bsnyen pa ni brjod zin to// gnyis pa sa'i cho ga ni kun rig nas/ gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal// mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs// ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yis// gnas ni byin gyis brlab pa tsam// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni// phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes 'byung bas/ sa chog bya dgos pa'i sa phyogs su rgyas par byed na/ rdo rje rtse mo'am/ gsang ba spyi rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin nam/ de dag gi don bsdus pa/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// de tsam bya ba ma grub na/ sa phyogs der gtor ma rgyas par btang la/ sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i mi ma yin pa la zhi bas bslang*/ khro bo'i sngags bzlas shing gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ drag pos bslang ngo*// lag pas mnan la sa gzhi nam mkhar bsgoms te/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi mdzes par ga dar legs pa bya'o// sa chog bsdus pa 'di ni bla ma'i gsung ngo*// gsum pa sta gon ni gzhung 'di na med pas ma byas kyang btub/ sa chog gi rjes la bri ba rgyas pa ma grub na byas kyang 'gal ba med pa de/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni// phyi'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ slob ma la chos zab mo bshad pa dang*/ sdom pa 'bogs par bshad pa'i skabs de/ bka' dang*/ bstan bcos phal nas sta gon du bshad pa'i phyir ro// de la byed par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor byi dor legs par byas pa'i steng du lha'i gnas ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir/

ci grub pa'i thig btab la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ mchod gtor rgyas par bshams te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs nas/ mdun du 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin lha bsgrubs la/ ji ltar 'byor pas mchod cing*/ gtor ma btang nas 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i slob ma 'jug pa yan chad byas nas/ ci bder gnas te/ nang par spyan drang ba'i dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol nas/ dkyil 'khor bri ba la 'jug par bya'o// bzhi pa dri zhing lha dgod pa ni gsum ste/ thig gis bri ba dang*/ tshon gyis bri ba dang*/ lha dgod pa'o// dang po ni kun rig las/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa// zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ rtsis ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya// zhes bya ba'i bar tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang lngas bstan te/ de yang mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o// sgo gnyis brtseg pa dang rkyang pa gnyis las/ gtso bor nyis brtseg par byed kyang*/ rkyang par bya bar mngon te/ lha dgod pa'i skabs nas/ gtso bo nas sgo'i bar rtsa ba'i lha sum cu so bdun bkod pa'i rjes la/ byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug la sogs pa mang po bkod pa bstan zhing*/ de'i rjes la sgo ba ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// tshon gyis bri ba ni spyir rgyud 'di nas thig tshon gnyis ka la byin gyis brlab pa ni ma bshad/ byas kyang 'gal ba med pas byed na/ rigs lnga'i sa bon las byung ba'i rigs lngar bskyed la/ ci 'byor bas mchod de/ de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du bsam mo// ji ltar bri ba'i kha dog ni/ rgyud nas bshad pa med kyang*/ mthong ba brgyud pas shes so// dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo// chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la// lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la// rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya// zhes bya ba tshon ni 'khor lo'i lte bar le tse dgur byas pa'i dbus dkar/

shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mtshams rnams zur thig gis bcad pa'i shar la sogs pa rnams phyogs mdog rdo rje'i gdung ci mdzes/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug sngon po/ nang dang phyi'i mu khyud dang*/ gong ras dang re'u mig rnams ci mdzes/ sgo gnyis ka'i nang phyogs tshon rtsig pa lnga ni nang dkar/ de nas ljang*/ de nas dmar/ de nas ser/ sngon po phyi rol lo// 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa phyed sngo/ mda' yab dang*/ rta babs ci mdzes/ nang ma la med/ phyi'i sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog rta babs kyi phyi rol khor yug ni/ sgo phyed tsam gyis bskor te/ ser po'am/ dkar po'am/ sngon pos kyang 'gal ba med do// der lha dgod pa ni thams cad kyi gdan padma dang zla ba ste/ rgyud las/ tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs so// zhes gsungs pas so// lha ji ltar dgod na rgyud las/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni// zhes pa nas brtsams te/ sgo ba bzhi po bri bar bya// zhes pa'i bar tshigs su bcad pa bdun gyis/ rtsa ba'i lha so bdun dgod pa bstan te/ sku rdzogs pa'am gdan rdzogs pa dgod par bya'o// brtan par gyis ni thams cad du// byams pa la sogs bri bar bya// nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang*// de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams// khro bo mngag pa pho nya sogs// bri bya yang na ming yang rung*// zhes pas byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug nyan thos bcu drug rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ khro bo brgyad/ pho nya bzhi/ bran bzhi ste/ bcu drug rnams sku dngos sam/ ming ngam/ brda'am/ thig le ru bri'o// phyi rol gyi khor yug la ni/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor phyi rol du zhes pa nas/ dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams// zhes bya ba'i bar tshigs bcad drug gis 'jig rten pa dgod pa bstan to// de dag ji ltar dgod na/ ming dang brda'am yang na ni// thig le rnams kyang bri bar bya// zhes pas bri'o// lha de dag kyang gtso bo lnga la sogs pa dgod/

sngags yod pa rnams rang gi sngags kyis 'god la/ gzhan rnams ni rtsa ba'i rig pa gdon zhing dgod par bya'o// zhib tu 'og tu rtog par 'gyur ro// lnga pa sbyang ba'i rten dgod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhor khru gang pa la padma dkar po'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po bya/ gong ras la sogs pa gzhan mdzes tshon gyis bris pa'i steng du ro'am/ rus pa'am/ gos sam/ gzugs sam/ rus pa las byas pa'i sātstsha'am/ ming bzhag par bya'o// drug pa rgyan dgram pa la gsum/ mchod pa bsham pa dang*/ bum pa bsham pa dang*/ gtor ma bsham pa'o// dang po ni de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la// bla re rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang*// gdugs dang rnga ma lda ldi dang*// 'phan dang sna tshogs na bzas mchod// ces pas ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams bsham par bya'o// bum pa ni/ rgyas par byed na nyi shu rtsa gnyis dgos te/ mchod pa'i bum pa bcu drug dbang bskur ba'i bum pa lnga/ rnam rgyal dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni// brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung*// zhes pas mchod pa'i bum pa/ dbang bskur rin chen chus bkang ba'i// bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya// zhes pas dbang gi lnga/ rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus// rab tu bkang ste bzhag par bya// zhes pas rnam rgyal lo// de kun la bum pa mdzes pa dri ma med pa mgul chings dang kha rgyan dang*/ nang du sman lnga 'bru lnga rin po che lnga gzhug pa la ni khyad par med/ mchod pa'i bum pa la ni mtshan ma med/ rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dgod/ dbang gi bum pa re re la 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ rnam rgyal ni dbus su dgod do// dbang gi bum pa ni phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga/ mchod pa'i bum pa ni/ ras yug gi mtha' ma na phar snyoms par dgod do// de tsam ma 'byor na ni/ mchod pa'i bum pa ni/ 'khar phor la sogs pa mchod yon gyi snod kyis gtub pas bum pa drug dang*/

de'ang med na rnam rgyal dang*/ dbang gi bsres pa lnga/ de'ang ma 'byor na rnam rgyal gcig pur bsdu'o// gtor ma ji tsam 'byor tshad yin la/ bzhi tsam ni cis kyang 'byor dgos so// bdun pa bdag gi rnal 'byor bum pa'i bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni/ de ltar thams cad rdzogs par bshams la/ gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad ci dgos pa legs par bshams shing*/ 'tshogs par byas la/ bdag nyid khrus byas rgyan gyis brgyan la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung du stan bde ba la bsdad la/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'das pa la rjes su brtse ba'i bdag nyid sngon du song ba'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yun ci rigs pa cig bsgom par bya ste/ de'ang kun rig las/ de nas khrus la sogs byas la// dri dang phreng sogs phreng ba can// dri zhim kha bkang mchog mdzes pa// rdo rje 'dzin pas zhugs nas kyang*// me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /ces pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa yang de'i gong nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems// bla na med pa rtog gyur pa'i// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang*// de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs// zhes 'byung bas bstan to// de ltar byang chub kyi sems dran pa dang bcas pas cho ga la 'jug par bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis// bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas ni// zhes bya bas bsrung ba bsdus pa'am/ yang na rgyas par byed na/ gzhung de la brten nas bla ma brgyud pa rnams/ 'dir rdo rje 'byung ba la sogs pa nas 'byung ba'i bsrung ba dang*/ gzhan nas 'byung ba'i khro bo'i bstod pa la sogs pa mdzad la/ de la las kha tshar ba zhes bya bar 'dogs so// de la drug

srung 'khor sgom/ khro bor bstod/ bgegs la bka' bsgo/ hūm̐ bzhis bsrung*/ las kyi sems dpa' bzhis bsrung*/ brtan par bya ba'o// de la dang po ni/ 'di ltar bya ste/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags pas/ chos bdag med pas/ nang gi khrus byas la/ lkog mar hrīḥlas padma 'dab brgyad/ lce'i padmar hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po nyal thabs su bskyed la/ oṃ badzra dzi hwa zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba gnyis kyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis zhu ba las rdo rje'i sor mor bsam mo// de nas yi ge hūm̐ las bdag nyid rdo rje me ltar 'bar bar bsams la/ oṃ grihna badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ bam̐/ zhes bya ba brjod nas/ khro bo ti rinti ri'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes bya bas spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re bsams la/ dbang blang ngo*// oṃ ṭuṃ zhes bya ba brjod cing go bgo ba ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdud pa 'ching ba bzhin byed pas/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ ltag pa dang*/ yang snying ga dang*/ nu ma'i bar dang*/ yang snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ rgyab dang*/ dpral ba rnams su mdud la rna ba'i steng du bshog pa bzhin/ lag pas lcug phye la/ badzra tuṣṭ+ya ho zhes thal mo'i rtse sprad nas gsham brdabs la/ yid kyis dar dkar po zhing du khru gang ba/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig pa gcig gis gnas rnams su mdud nas/ rna ba'i steng na yar lcugs byas nas/ lhag ma mar brkyang pas lus dang mnyam par bsam mo// oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ g.yas pas bgegs la bsnun par bya'o// oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod cing*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas bgegs bsreg par bya'o// rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya bcings la/

badzra ne tri bandha sarb+ba bighnān/ zhes bya bas bgegs bcing ngo*// rdo rje bsdams pa sa la brkyang ste/ oṃ badzra dṛ ḍho mi bhā ba rakṣa sarb+baṃ swā hā/ zhes pas 'og bcing*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya bas steng bcing*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes bya bas de'i 'og gi steng bcing*/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ drūṃ bandha ham̐/ zhes bya bas shar phyogs bcing*/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra pā sha hrīḥzhes bya bas/ yang shar bcing*/ rdo rje ba dan gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ pā taṃ ke pā taṃ ki ni ra ṭaḥ zhes bya bas nub bcing*/ rdo rje nag mo'i phyag rgya dang*/ hrīḥbadzra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ zhes bya bas byang bcing*/ rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya dang*/ hūm̐ badzra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa/ zhes pas lho bcing*/ rdo rje las dang*/ hūm̐ badzra karm+ma zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor bcing*/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang*/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas nang rdo rje'i rwa ba bcing*/ bcing zhes bya ba thams cad ni/ steng la sogs pa rdo rje'i rnam par bsam mo// rdo rje bsdams pa dang*/ badzra bandha bam̐ zhes bya bas thams cad kyi phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa bar bsam mo// gnyis pa khro bos khro bo spyan drangs zhing bstod pa ni/ bdag me ltar 'bar ba'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs te/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po'i dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po mtha' gnod dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes bya bas khro bo mang po spyan drangs la/

sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod pa lnga dbul lo// de nas bstod pa bya ste/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spang zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen gtan nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod do// gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// zhes brjod do// bzhi pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings la/

snying gar reg cing oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ dpral bar oṃ grihna grihna hūm̐/ lkog mar/ oṃ grihnā pa ya/ grihnā pa ya hūm̐/ spyi bor oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān/ bidya rā dzā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bdag bsrung*/ yang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ sngags de nyid kyis shar nas bzung ste/ phyogs bzhi dang*/ me nas bzung ste mtshams bzhir/ g.yas skor du byas pas/ gnas dang*/ rnal 'byor bsrungs te/ bgegs med par bya'o// lnga pa las kyi sems dpa' bzhis bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bo dang*/ mthe'u chung rtse mo sprad de bkyed la/ oṃ badzra karmā kam̐ zhes lan gsum dang*/ rdo rje bsrung ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bo dang*/ mthe'u chung dang*/ mdzub mo rnams rtse sprad de/ bkyed la snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo dang*/ mthe'u chung brkyang pa bcings la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i nang du mthe bo gnyis bcug pa'i rgyab mdzub mos mnan pa bcings la/ oṃ badzra sandhi bam̐/ zhes rdo rje khu tshur lan gsum brjod de/ de rnams kyis brtan par bsrungs la/ drug pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bya'o// de dag ni rgyas par bya ba ste/ bla ma brgyud pa'i las kha tshar ba zhes bya ba yin la/ de tsam ma grub na/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi bdag bsrung khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ khro bo'i bstod pa bya ba'am/ shin tu bsdus nas byed na/ bstod pa ma byas par yang 'jug pa yin no// rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa ni/ shin tu bsdus pa nyid yin no// //de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ mdun du ras bris sam/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yod kyang rung ste/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dpa' bo gcig pa las/

dkyil 'khor mi bsgom zhes gsung ngo*// shin tu spros pa la dga' na/ dkyil 'khor bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med la ches bzang ngo zhes kyang gsung la/ mngon rtogs ni/ sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs nyid du brjod zin to// de la dang po dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor byed na yang*/ ya tha bdag bsrung gnas bsrung nas bzung ste/ ma tha ngan song gi rgyud las grol bar byas nas/ ched du brjod pa yan chad ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs nyid du bstan zin la/ mchod bstod dang*/ bzlas pa'ang der bstan zin mod kyi/ cung zad rgyas par byed na/ ngan song gi rgyud sbyangs nas/ ched du brjod pa'i rjes la/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes pas bsang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ sngags kyis gzi brjid bskyed/ mchod yon la sogs pa rang rang gi sngags brjod cing*/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsams la/ 'bul ba'i tshe/ ngag tu brjod pa rnams/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ bdag gis brjod/ yid kyis rigs drug ngan song las thar ba rnams kyis/ bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa la/ mchod bstod byed par bsam zhing dbul te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo rnams bcug la oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya ba dang*/ me tog gi phyag rgyas dbul/ de bzhin du/ puṣpe'i gnas su/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ zhes bya ba bcug la rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul bar bya'o// rol mo yang dbul lo// de bzhin du rgyas par byed par spro na/

mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bdag la mchod par bya ste/ 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba rnams kyis mchod do// spros pa 'bring la dga' ba rnams kyis de tsam gyis so// bsdus pa la dga' na/ sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin/ sngags tsam gyis mchod do// de nas bstod pa ni/ ngan song las grol ba rnams dang*/ lha chen po rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ bdag la bstod par bsam ste/ rgyud las/ brgya byin tshangs pa la sogs lhas// phyag 'tshal yang dang yang du ni// rin chen gdugs la sogs mchog gis// mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas kyang*// phyag na rdo rje rgyal spyan la// dga' ba'i bsam pas stong byed pa// zhes gsungs pas so// dngos su bdag nyid kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas// mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa// rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje sku ste sku che ba// phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje'i yan lag rdo rje'i mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba// rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba// rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che// phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po// rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa// rdo rje rnon po rno ba che// che ba'i che ba rgya mtsho che// rdo rje padma byung chub che// byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba// rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen te// rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che// rdo rje padma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che// rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso// rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba che// rdo rje lcags kyus don yod byed// rdo rje ro langs ro langs che// rdo rje srin po za ba po// rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che// rdo rje gdon te gdon gyi mchog

/'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che// rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa// bsgrub dka'i sgrub pa legs pa ste// rdo rje legs pa dgyes mdzad pa// rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che// dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ 'od stug pas na stug pa che// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'o// re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho// rdo rje ye shes ye shes che// rig sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// ha la ha la nag po che// sgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can// rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che// snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba// skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod// glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro// rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul// drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa// nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal// spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po// khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro// phyag rnams du ma mtshon cha brgya// du ma'i zhal te sku yang ston// 'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyil pa ste// sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'// rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul// ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste// 'dod chags zhe sdang dri mthar mdzad// sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can// rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba// zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa// sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku// rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems// kun tu bzang po cher bzang po// mtshan rnams dam pas rab brgyan pa// khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtso// zhes bya bas bstod la/ de nas ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ bdag gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du/ rtsa rig la sogs pa gang zlos pa rnams bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/

khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas/ yang rang gi snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ yang sngar bzhin bsam zhing*/ sngags ji tsam spro ba bzhin bzlas par bya'o// de nas skabs 'dir bum pa la bzlas te/ mchod pa'i bum pa la lha ni mi dgos/ rtsa rig bzla bar bya'o// dbang gi bum pa rnams la rigs lnga bskyed pa'am/ ma bskyed kyang rung ste/ rtsa rig dang rigs lnga'i sngags bzlas so// rnam rgyal la ni/ lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed pa'am/ ma bskyed kyang rung ste/ lha thams cad kyi sngags bzlas so// grangs ni kun rig las/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la// brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni// zhes gsungs so// lha bskyed na ni lha la mchod la/ de las byang sems kyi chu rgyun sku thams cad las 'dzag cing*/ de'i rjes la zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bsam zhing bzlas so// lha ma bskyed na ma mchod pas btub bo// chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam pa las med do// de nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas te/ lha sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o// brgyad pa lha bsgrub par bya ba ni/ 'di la dge bshes gnyal pa na re/ rdo rje 'dzin ma bzhugs nas ni// zhes bya ba la brten nas/ mdun du lha ma bsgrubs par/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len la/ de nas lha sgrub pa yin zer ba ni ma yin te/ lha ma bsgrubs par rdul tshon du zhugs pa la don med pa dang*/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas/ lha rnams spyan drang ngo*// de bzhin gshegs par mos pa bskyed de/ mchod pa byas nas/ de bzhin du bcug ste dbang bskur nas zhes pa dang*/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas kyang*/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la/ bde bar gshegs pa dam pa sras dang 'bangs su bcas shing 'khor gyis bskor te/ rig pa dang lhan cig spyan drang ngo*// de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te/

zhes bshad pa'i rjes la/ slob ma'i dbang rnams bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'o na rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang zhugs/ zhes bya ba rnams ci yin snyam na/ zhugs zhes bya ba thams cad ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas zhugs pa yin no// zhes rin chen bzang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung ngo*// de ni rigs so// de bas na lha sgrub pa sngon la bya'o// des bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas pa gnyis so// bsdus te byed na/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i skabs bzhin spyan drangs la/ de bzhugs su gsol la/ phyag rgya bstan te/ mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas mchod de/ 'jug pa la sogs pa bya'o// de bas na ye shes pa spyan drang ba man chad ni 'dra'o// rgyud nas ni de nyid gsal bar bzhugs/ rgyas par byed na/ gong gi dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa bzhin mdun du yang byed do// de ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sha/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor stong par bsam/ oṃ bha zhes brjod pas/ skad cig gis 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa bris pa bzhin ches rdzogs par mdzes par bsam/ de nas snying po tshig tsam gyis lha thams cad bskyed pa'am/ spro bsdu las bskyed pa gang yang rung bar bya'o// dang po ni/ oṃ sarb+ba bita sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ dbus su kun rig zhal bzhi pa/ seng ge'i gdan can sku mdog dkar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs par bsam/ spro bsdu las bskyed na gdan gyi steng du snying po blos bskyed/ mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i tshul du byas nas/ 'od bsdus te yi ge la zhugs pa las kun rig du bskyed do// 'og ma rnams la'ang cho ga de nyid kyis bsgres la shes par bya ste rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o// oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/

mdun du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba bita phaṭa/ g.yas su rgyal mchog dkar po'am/ sngon po ting nge 'dzin nam/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin la g.yas mchog sbyin pas bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarb+ba bid aḥ rgyab tu shāka thub ser po chos 'chad pas bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarb+ba bid tra tha/ g.yon du rin chen me tog dkar po'am/ ljang gu ting nge 'dzin nam/ skyabs sbyin gyis bzhugs pa'o// mtshams su lha mo bzhi bskyed pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas bshad pa bzhin te/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ne hūm̐/ mer spyan ma dkar mo spyan 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra mā ma kī trām̐/ srin por mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra paṇḍa rī de hi de hi siddhi bodhi lo kotta rimba swā hā/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo padma 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badzra tā re tuttā re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swā hā/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma ljang gu utpal 'dzin pa'o// de rnams kun kyang phyag g.yon pa rnams ni gdan la brten pa'o// de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug la sems dpa' bcu drug bskyed par bya ste/ shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la rim pa bzhin du bskyed de/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dzaḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang gu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster ba'o// lho'i rtsibs bzhi la/ trām̐ las rdo rje rin chen ser po/ g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ rya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma 'dzin pa/ bhri las rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o// nub kyi rtsibs bzhi pa/

hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dkar dmar/ g.yon pas padma 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas pas de kha 'byed pa'o// dhīḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po/ g.yas pas ral gri/ g.yon pas pu sti'o// krum̐ las rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'o// bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa'o// byang gi rtsibs bzhi la/ kam̐ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa'o// ram̐ las rdo rje srung ba ser po go cha 'dzin pa'o// kṣam̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis mche ba zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad ka gnyis su 'dzin pa'o// sam̐ las rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dam tshig gi khur tshur gyis 'dzin pa'o// yang nang gi mtshams bzhir/ hūm̐ las mer sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa'o// trām̐ las srin por phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje phreng ba 'dzin pa'o// hrīḥlas rlung du glu ma dkar dmar pi wang 'dzin pa'o// aḥlas dbang ldan du gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o// yang de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir/ hūm̐ las mer bdug pa ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa'o// trām̐ las srin por me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa'o// hrīḥlas rlung du mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'o// aḥlas dbang ldan du dri ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos bsnams pa'o// phyi'i lha mo rnams ni/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis bskyed kyang btub bo// dzaḥlas shar gyi sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o// hūm̐ las lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa'o// bam̐ las nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o// hoḥlas byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa'o// lha de dag thams cad ni rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

dar gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ padma dang zla ba'i steng na/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ni/ rdo rje skyil krung can la/ gzhan thams cad ni/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// rdo rje gnod sbyin gcig pu ni khro bo yin no// kha cig na re/ sgo ba bzhi ni bzhengs pa'i khro bor bzhugs so// zhes zer te/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams nas ma bshad pa'i phyir ma yin no// de'i phyi rol tu mgron thabs kyi lha rnams bskyed par bya ste/ sngags ni rtsa rig go /de la rgyas par byed na/ lha re re la sngags re bya/ 'bring du byed na/ phyogs kyi grangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bzhi/ rang rgyal rnams la bzhi/ nyan thos rnams la bzhi/ phyi rol rnams la bzhi byed do// bsdus nas byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gcig rang rgyal rnams la gcig nyan thos rnams la gcig phyi'i sgo na gnas pa'i khro bo la sogs pa rnams la gcig khor yug gi 'jig rten pa rnams la gcig gis bskyed par bya'o// de la/ brtan par khyams ni thams cad du// byams pa la sogs bri bar bya// zhes 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ni byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi shar du/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes rtog bzhi lho ru/ 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi nub tu/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi byang du/ thams cad kyang phyogs kyi sku mdog can/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ste/ kun dga' snying pos rdo rje 'byung ba las/ ji ltar dga' ba'i sku mdog dang*/ rgyan can no zhes bshad do// de'i phyi rol du/ nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ zhes pa'i don nyan thos bcu drug ni/ shar nas rim pa bzhin/

phyogs re re bzhi bzhi ste/ 'phags pa dga' bo dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ mau'u gal dang*/ rab 'byor dang*/ 'char ka dang*/ ma 'gags pa dang*/ kauṇḍi n+ya dang*/ nye ba 'khor dang*/ rta thul dang*/ ba lang bdag dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ ming chen dang*/ nor sbyin 'dzin dang*/ gang po dang*/ 'od srungs so// de dag la kha cig na re rang rgyal bzhin bcu gnyis las mi 'dod do// de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams// zhes pa ni/ de'i phyi rol du// rang rgyal ni bcu gnyis te rten 'brel bcu gnyis yin pa'i phyir ro// de'ang phyogs rer gnyis gnyis/ mtshams su re re ste/ rim pa bzhin du/ gdung ba sel ba dang*/ snang ba brtsegs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ dpa' bo 'dul ba dang*/ shes rab mgyogs chen dang*/ ri bo rgyal dang*/ smra ba'i sgra chen dang*/ bse ru lta bu dang*/ dug sel 'joms dang*/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston dang*/ seng ge sgra dang*/ yid myur rnams so// de ltar dgra bcom dang*/ rang rgyal ba rnams kyi sku mdog la ni nges pa med la/ phyag na pu sti dang*/ lhung bzed dang*/ 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa'o// khro bo mngag pa pho nya sogs// zhes pa'i don me ltar 'bar ba nas 'byung ba bzhin du bya ste/ phyi'i sgo'i phyogs su khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngag pa bzhi/ bran bzhi bskyed de/ shar gyi sgor 'jig rten gsum snang*/ de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ rgyab kyi phyogs su dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang du 'jig rten gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo// rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma'o// de dag thams cad ni/

sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing*/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan can no// byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug nas gzung ste/ bran gyi bar rnams sgo nyis brtsegs su byed na sgo phyi ma'i nang gi khyams su dgod la/ sgo rkyang las mi byed na ni/ rta babs kyi phyi rol gyi khyams su dgod par bya ste/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad par byed pa'i kun rig gi gzhung yang de bzhin byed de/ de nyid las/ to ra na yi khyams par na// dpe bral sems dpa' bcu drug ni// zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad do// phyi rol gyi khor yug la/ phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa/ 'jig rten pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzhung nas 'byung ba rnams skad cig gis bsam par bya'o// mgron thabs kyi lha de dag thams cad kyi sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa mos pa tsam las gsal bar ma bskyed kyang*/ 'gal ba ni med do zhes gsung ngo*// de ltar mdun du dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ rgyas pa'i cho ga yin pas/ de la ye shes pa spyan 'dren no// //bsdus pa la dga' bas ni/ rdul tshon la ye shes pa spyan drang zhing*/ shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas ni/ ras bris dang*/ lugs ma la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ 'og nas 'byung bas mchod pa yin pas 'di man chad thams cad kyi cho ga thun mong ba yin no// de la ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i cho ga la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas pa la dga' bas 'di ltar bya ste/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ spos 'dzin pa'i sngags pas dbyangs dang bcas la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/ yang byed par 'dod na de'i steng du brjod pa/ bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas nas gshegs su gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/

yang byed par 'dod na de'i steng du brjod pa/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje cher ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun du mi zad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pas 'di ru gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes bya ba dang*/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba bzhin/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bha ga wān e hye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ shya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de la thog mar mchod yon dbul te/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas khrus gsol te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de nas gdan dbul te/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/

zhes pas gdan phul la mchod de/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa// tshim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na// lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba// chu dang thang skyes yid byung 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ni// lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs// dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na// lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas// yon tan kun ldan gang yod de// thub dbang la ni dbul bar bya// 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi// rin chen mar me la sogs pa// snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// de nas de'i zhabs la phyag byas la/ kun rig las 'byung ba bzhin/ lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis// gsang ba'i bcing bas bcings nas ni// mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du byas// zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang*// de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya// mtheb gnyis nang du bcug nas kyang*// bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes bya ba dang sbyar la/ yid kyis ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas la/ de nas phyag rgya bstan par bya ba ni/ 'di dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs su yang dgos te/ de la phyag rgya la bka' dang bstan bcos gzhan bzhin/ phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyas gdab pa ni/ rgyud 'dir mi gsung ste/ legs par brtags na/ phyag rgya bzhir mngon par ni kho bos mthong ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni dngos su bshad la/ las kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rjes la/ de nyid gnyis su byas nas/ gar byas na las kyi'o// zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgya'ang*/ de nyid las/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon lta bu bshad la/

phyag rgya chen po ni/ shugs la grub pa yin no// de ni kho bo'i rtogs pa'o// 'dir bla ma rnams kyi gsung ni/ gong du brjod pa bzhin/ lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgya bstan/ de nas rang rang gi phyag rgya bstan te/ rtsa rig dang*/ rang rigs kyi sngags brjod kyang rung ma brjod kyang rung ste/ rang rang gi phyag rgya bcings la/ sems can ngan song las gdon pa'i las gzhol zhing*/ rang rang gi sku de la yid kyis legs par brtag pa yin no// de'ang phyogs gcig la mtshon na/ kun rig gi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcings la/ kun rig gi sku la rtog cing*/ ngag tu/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ sems can rnams ngan song las gdon pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod par bya'o// de bzhin du/ nang gi rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar ram/ sgo phyi ma'i dus kyi 'bebs pa'i bar gyi phyag rgya bcings la/ dus kyi 'bebs pa'i sku yid la byed pas/ dus kyi 'bebs pas sems can thams cad ngan song las gdon pa'i las mdzod cig ces brjod par bya'o// 'jig rten pa rnams la phyag rgya ston na ni/ phyag rgya bstan la/ de dag gi sku yid la byed pas 'jig rten 'dir rang gi yid la ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa'i las dang*/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las gzhol bar bya'o// de la phyag rgya nyid ni rgyud nas shāka thub dang*/ 'khor los sgyur pa gnyis nas/ gong 'og 'khrugs pa rnams bsdebs nas brjod par bya'o// lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du pang du bzhag la/ de'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag ste/ mthe bo gnyis ngos gnyis su sprad la/ zhi ba'i lta bas blta ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ste dam tshig yin par bshad do// rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo dang mtha' ma bzhi bsgreng*/ mdzub mo dang*/

srin lag gnyis padma 'dra bar byas pa ni ngan song sbyong ba'i 'o// de nyid las/ mdzub mo dang*/ srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya ste rin chen me tog gi'o// mthe'u chung dang*/ mthe bo mnyam la/ lhag ma 'bar bar bya ba ni/ sdig pa sreg pa ste shāka thub kyi'o// de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba ni las thams cad pa ste rgyal mchog gi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs dang por btsugs te mig 'dra bar byas/ srin lag mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa'i steng mthe bos mnan pa ni spyan gyi mig dang 'dra bar bshad do// thal mo sbyar ba las srin lag dang*/ mtheb chen nang du bcug pa'am/ ma bcug kyang rung ste/ mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar gung mo la blta ba ni mā ma kī'i rdo rjer bshad do// thal mo sbyar ba las/ gung mo gnyis padma ltar byas la/ mthe'u chung so sor phral ba ni/ gos dkar mo'i padmar bshad do// thal mo sbyar ba las/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris te/ mthe bo gung mo la sbyar la lhag ma bsnol ba ni utpal ni sgrol mar dgongs zhes pa'o// sems dpa' bcu drug gi la/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas ma tshang ba'i 'khrugs nas gsungs pa rnams ni/ las sgrub pa'i skabs yin yang*/ mi 'dra ba ni gnyis tsam las med de/ 'dir bstan pa'i phyag rgya ni/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas bshad par bya'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o// de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa ni lcags kyu'o// de nyid las me tog gi mda' 'dra bar byas pa ni mda'i phyag rgya'o// de nyid las slar bkug ste/ mthe bo gnyis rtse sprad pa ni blo gros legs pa'i 'o// de nyid las tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin po che'i 'o// de nyid las sor mo lhag ma 'od zer 'bar ba ltar bya ba ni gzi brjid kyi'o// de nyid las spyi bor bzhag pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o// de nyid kha'i thad kar bskor te bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las/

mdzub mo padma 'dra bar byas pa ni padma'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bkug pa ni rnon po'i 'o// de nyid las gdu bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'khor lo'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo padma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar byas nas cung zad kha phye ba ni lce'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bkyed pa ni rgya gram gyi'o// de nyid las shin tu bkyed pa ni bsrung ba'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o// mdun du bkug pa ni bsdams pa'o// de nas nang gi lha mo bzhi ni/ rgyud 'di nas ma bshad pa/ de nyid bsdus pa nas 'byung ba/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag de nyid brkyang ba phreng ba'o// rdo rje thal mo kha nas dbyung*// gar las thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag /ces pa'o// phyi'i bzhi ni/ 'di nyid shāka thub las/ bsdams pa nyid mdun du bzhag pa ni bdug pa'i 'o// de nyid las gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog gi'o// mdun du mthe bo gnyis mnyam te bskor ba ni mar me'i 'o// de nyid byug pa ltar byas pa ni dri'i 'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis ka'i rtse mo bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sprad pa ni zhags pa'i 'o// de nyid gcig la gcig mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o// de nyid las bskyod pa ni mnyes pa'o// de nas phyi'i khyams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal ba rnams la ni/ rgyud nas phyag rgya ma bshad pas/ rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya tshan gsum la lan gsum bstan par bya'o// zhes gsung ngo*// kun dga' snying pos mdzad do// zhes zer ba'i kun rig gi cho ga de nas phyag rgya gsum bshad de/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las// gung mo srin lag rtse mnyam bsgreng*// mthe'u chung gnyis ni nang du gzhug /mdzub mo gnyis ni bkug byas la// bcar ba byang sems spyi yi'o// thal mo mnyam du sbyar ba las// snying gar bzhag pa nyan thos kyi'o// g.yon gyi khu tshur nang bstan te// mdzub mo mthe bo rtsa sbyar bsgreng*// g.yas pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bsgreng sprad// rang rgyal rnams kyi phyag rgya'o// zhes bshad pas gang 'grub bya'o// de nas khro bo dang*/

pho nya la sogs pa rnams la/ rgyud las/ phyag rgya so so ba dang*/ spyi gnyis bshad pa'i so so ba ni/ rang gi dkyil 'khor me ltar 'bar ba la dgongs la/ 'dir spyi'i bstan te/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la gung mo rtse sprad de brkyang*/ mtha' ma bzhi so sor bsgreng ba ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba nas/ de nyid las nang du bkug pa ni/ khro bo sna tshogs pa'i phyag rgya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'jig rten pa rnams la phyag rgya so sor bshad pa rnams la ni/ rang rang gi dkyil 'khor la dgongs pa yin la/ spyi'i phyag rgya bcu bshad pa rnams ni/ dkyil 'khor 'dir dgongs pa yin pas/ de bshad pa/ thal mo sbyar ba las/ dbus ma gsum bkug ste rtse sprad tha ma bzhi bkyed pa ni/ lha rnams kun dang thun mong du// padma'i phyag rgya bkra shis te// gung mo gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo ma reg par bkug mthe bo gnyis gshibs la bsgreng*/ lhag ma bsnol ba ni/ klu rnams zhes bya utpal/ lag pa gnyis gshibs pa'i sen mo rnams so ltar gshibs la/ mdzub mo mche ba ltar bya ba ni/ de ltar so ni gnod sbyin rnams// 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// srin po'i ni g.yas pa'i snyim pa mgo tshal du ston pa ste/ srin po rnams kyi mgo tshal lo// sor mo kun bsnol ba ni/ bud med rnams kyi sor bcu bsnol// g.yon snying gar bsdus te g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa lta bu ni/ gza' rnams kyi ni dbyug pa ste// thal mo gnyis mdun du bkan pa'i srin lag bkug pa ni/ argha dbul ba rgyu skar rnams// lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo bcu'i rtse bkug pa sprad pa'i snyim pa ni/ mgo bo'i thod pa khar bzhag pa// phyag rgya 'di ni phra men ma// de nyid las/ mthe bong gnyis nang du lce lta bur bya ba ni/ mgo thod lce yi phyag rgya ni// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yir bshad/ phyag rgya gong ma dgu po bstan pa'i rjes sam/

gong ma dgu po bstan pa grub kyang rung ste/ 'jig rten pa spyi'i phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba brkyang la pad kor bya ste/ thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba'o// de dag kun gyi thun mong du// phyag rgya chen po bshad par bya// thal mo brkyang bar bshad pa ste// yang na thal mo padmor bya// zhes pa'o// rang rang gi sngags sam/ rtsa rig brjod pa'i rjes la/ phrin las gzhol bar bya'o// 'jig rten pa'i phyag rgya de dag bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ de dag gis sems dga' bas/ bdag gi dbang du gyur nas/ bsgo ba rnams nyan par 'gyur ba ste/ rgyud las/ de dag kun gyi sems sgrub pa'o// zhes 'byung bas so// shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba la ni/ phyag rgya bstan mi dgos so// lha sgrub pa brjod zin to// //dgu pa mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bya ba la gnyis/ 'das pa'i lha mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyin pa'o// de la mchod pa ni/ rgyud las/ argha mchog brtags gsang la sogs pa yi// dbyangs snyan pa yis bstod dang lha rdzas kyi// mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod// ces pas dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba ste lha mo brgyad dang*/ sogs pa ste mchod pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa dang*/ lha rdzas te yis las byung bar rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'o// de las dang por dngos su 'byor pa bshams pa rnams la/ me tog za ba la sogs pa'i bgegs bsal bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra ya kṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya bas gzi brjid bskyed/ mchod yon la sogs pa rang rang gi sngags brjod cing*/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la dkyil 'khor la dbul/ ngag tu dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis dbul bar bya ste/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes pas mchod yon no// de bzhin du/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// me tog ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// bdug spos ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// dri chab ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai bi dye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes pas zhal zas so// rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarb+ba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ti pra dzñā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bha be badzra dharmā hṛ da ya santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i mchod pa bya'o// de dag ni arghaṃ la sogs pa dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa ji ltar 'byor pas/ mchod par bya'o// de nas sogs pa'i mchod pa bya ba'am/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ sngon la gang byas kyang 'dra ste/ de la sogs pa ni ci 'byor zhing grub pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo bzhin/ ngo mtshar ba'i mchod pa bco brgyad dang*/ 'di nyid nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa nyid shu rtsa lnga'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje rtse mo nyid bzhin nam/ de'i don rdo rje 'byung bar bshad pa bzhin bya ste/ ya tha phyag bya ba nas brtsams te/ ma tha gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bar mchod pa nyi shu dang*/ lus 'bul ba dang*/ dngos grub blang ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i bar bya ste/ rdo rje 'byung ba'am/ rdo rje rtse mor blta bar bya'o// de nas 'di nyid nas 'byung ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ kun rig nas 'byung ba dang*/ sngon byung nor bu dri ma med pas byas pa yin la/ rjes 'jug gi bya ba ni/ rgyu rin po che las byas par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ glur blang ba ni thun mong pa'o// de la rgyan gyi khyad par brgyad dang*/ yo byad kyi khyad par drug dang*/ gnas kyi khyad par drug dang*/ mchod pa'i khyad par lnga'o// de la rgyan gyi khyad par ni rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o// lus kyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las 'byung ba'i gar sngon la song bas/

khu tshur gnyis rang gi mgo bo'i steng du dbang bskur ba'i tshul du 'jog cing dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ rin po che'i cod paṇa bcings par bsams te/ de bzhin du kun la bsgre'o// rang gi rna ba la rna rgyan/ mgul ba la mgul rgyan/ brang la do shal/ lag pa g.yon pas/ g.yas kyi dpung par dpung rgyan/ mkhrig ma g.yas pa gdu bu/ g.yas pa'i gung mo la sor gdub/ lag pa g.yas pas/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i bol la rkang rgyan 'dogs pa'i tshul du byed pa ste/ rgyan gyi khyad par rnam pa brgyad do// g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur du byas pa'i mthe bo'i steng du/ lag pa'i thal mo mthur du gdugs phub pa'i tshul du byas la/ gdugs dbul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brtsegs nas/ g.yon phyogs su rgyal mtshan phrag pa la khur ba'i tshul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la phan 'dogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yas pa khu tshur bcings nas/ mdzub mo dang*/ gung mo gnyis brkyang nas/ nam mkha' la lda ldi 'gel ba'i tshul/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul/ lag pa g.yon pas bsam gtan bya ba ltar byas la/ g.yas pa kha thur du bstan la/ bla re 'bul bar bsams te/ yo byad kyi khyad par rnam pa drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te/ seng ge'i gdan 'bul ba'i tshul du 'jog pa/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du drang zhing*/ gzims cha g.yogs pa'i tshul du/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i gung mo dang*/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis pho brang zlum po 'bul ba'i tshul/ phyag rgya de nyid gzhal med khang gru bzhi 'bul ba'i tshul/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis/ khang bu gru bzhi nyis brtsegs 'bul ba'i tshul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis zla ba'i gdan 'bul ba'i tshul te/ gnas kyi khyad par rnam pa drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis me tog 'thor ba'i tshul/ de nyid kyis sgra pi wang dang*/

ting ting shag brdung ba'o// g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis dri'i phye ma 'gyed pa'i tshul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bshos 'bul ba'i tshul/ de nyid kyis gos 'bul ba'i tshul te/ mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa lnga'o// de lta mchod pa nyi shu'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'am/ gnyis ka'am/ gang rung ngam/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa bya/ sogs pa zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de nas de dag gi sngon nam/ phyi gang du byas kyang btub pa'i gsang ba'i mchod pa ste lha mo brgyad kyis mchod de/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// rdo rje rin chen bla na med// rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa// rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// zhes bya'o// skad sor gzhag par bya ste/ gtso bor ni sor bzhag ste/ de nyid ni/ oṃ badzra satwa su saṃ gra ha da/ badzra ratna ma nutta raṃ/ badzra dharm+mā ga ya ne/ badzra ka rm+maḥko rodbha ba/ zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ zhes bya ba brjod de/ las kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ glu re dang*/ lha mo re spel yang btub/ glu dang*/ lha mo ma spel yang btub ste/ rang sgeg mor bsams pas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o// de bzhin du/ lā sye'i gnas su/ badzra mā le trāṃ/ badzra gī te hrīḥ badzra nṛ tye aḥzhes nang gi bzhi dang*/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe tram̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe aḥzhes pas/ phyi'i lha mo bzhi brjod cing*/ lus kyis gar sngon du 'gro bas las kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis su// bsam pa g.yos pas 'dud par bya// phreng ba bcing dang kha nas dbyung*// gar las thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag /'og tu blugs dang gyen du 'thor// mthe bong gshibs te bsgreng ba nyid// dris byug pa yi tshul du ni// mchod pa'i phyag rgyar rab tu brtag

/ces de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs pa yin no// de ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas sogs pa zhes gsungs pas/ ji ltar 'byor zhing*/ grub pas mchod par bya ste/ sems dpa' 'byung ba las gsungs pa/ oṃ las rin po che sna bdun dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ kha zas ro brgya pa'i bkod pa sprul la/ oṃ sarb+ba bita/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a brtā ya/ a brtā ya hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ de dag gis yang dag par mchod par bya'o// de dag las spros pa la dga' na/ rgyas par bya ste/ rin po che sna bdun ni/ mchog gi gong rgyal bas mdzad pa chen po la 'os par na de brjod pa/ lag pa gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol te rgyab sbyar la/ sor mo rnams gcig la gcig 'khyud nas/ mthe bo gnyis lag mthil du bkug la/ 'khor lo ltar byas nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul pas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ mthe bo gnyis rtse sprad de tshigs bcags la/ rgyas ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkres shing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i logs la mdzub mo gnyis gcig la gcig sbyar ba bcer te/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wa ti na ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gong mo dang tha ma bzhi gshibs te bsgreng la/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang ba theg gsum bstan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin zhing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog
