/oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā ta ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas pa glang po che'i sna lta bur brkyang ste/ g.yon pa'i gru mo nas bzung la/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong 'gro bar shog /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta hasti ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro bar bsams la/ khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa bcer ba'i gung mo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis brkyang mthe bo gnyis rna ba ltar byas la/ rin chen rta mchog 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi mchog thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa go cha 'dzin pa ltar byas/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa ltar byas nas/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob pa shog /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta khaḍga ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes bya bas/ rin chen sna bdun dbul lo// yang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yang sprul la dbul te/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ong rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapta kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed 'di// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandhe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te hūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog thams cad kyang*// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam zhing 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta parṣe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes bya bas 'dod yon lngas mchod do// gzhan yang ji ltar spros pa gzhung gzhan nas bshad pa byas kyang*/ 'gal ba med par mchod pa ci 'grub pas mchod par bya'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbyangs snyan pas bstod par bya ste/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la// me long ye shes rang bzhin las// sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa// phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la// mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyi// sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa// rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal// so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab padma kha rgyas pa// khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po// shākya'i rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal// nan tan ye shes phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun// ma lus pa ni zhi mdzad pa// me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang*// rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa// lha mo spyan dang mā ma kī// dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal// rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na// bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams// rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog

/rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs// nges pa'i rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la// rdo rje chags pa bde chen po// rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa// bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la// rdo rje legs pa sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che// rab dges rdo rje rgyal po mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dges khyod la// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don// rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che// nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la// rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od// rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la// sems can don rab rdo rje dpal// rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed// rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la// rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che// rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che// dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la// rdo rje chos rab de nyid don// rdo rje padmo rab dga' byed// 'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje spyan// phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la// rdo rje rno ba theg pa che// rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po// 'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab// phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la// rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che// rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po// rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying po la// rdo rje gsung ba rab rig mchog /rdo rje zlos pa rab grub phyir// mi gsung rdo rje mchog grub pa// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la// rdo rje las rab rdo rje dka'// las kyi rdo rje kun rab sgrol// rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba// phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la// rdo rje bsrung ba brtan pa che// rdo rje go cha sra ba che// brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'// phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la// rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po// rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che// bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa// phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la// rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab 'dud nyid// rdo rje 'ching ba rab grol byed// rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog

/phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la// rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma// mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas// rdo rje sgeg mo tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gying ma la// rnam dag yon tan rdo rje ste// yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong*/ rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje phreng ba la// rnam dag rdo rje gsung mchog ma// rdo rje pi wang 'dzin pa'i tshul// rdo rje gsung mchog sgrog pa'i don// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la// rnam dag rdo rje las rab ste// las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan la// sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma// tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pas// rdo rje phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje bdug pa la// rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs 'dzin zhing*// rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul// byang chub yan lag me tog ste// phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la// 'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// rdo rje spyan gyi ma rig sel// gsal byed rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snang byed la// rdo rje tsandan bdud rtsi'i chu// rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms// rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la// rnam dag skul byed rdo rje'i don// rdo rje sdud mdzad rdo rje'i don// rdo rje 'gugs mdzad phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags kyu la// mi gtang rdo rje chos kyi don// rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don// 'ching mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la// rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin myur// sgrog mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la// rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag

/skyod mdzad rdo rje kun gyi las// rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la// sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi// byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni// rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i// byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar gsil pu sti'i phyag /bslab sbyang yon tan kun ldan pa'i// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel don la rten gnas pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni// 'byung dang ldog la rab zhugs pa// rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can// sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa// stag lpags kyis ni snam dkris pa'i// 'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal// phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i// 'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang*// phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'jig rten pa kun mchod par bgyi// zhes bya ba'am/ rgyas pa la dga' na yang bstod pa rgyas par bya ste/ logs shig tu brjod par bya'o// gzhan yang lha rdzas mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba ni/ yid las byung ba dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug la sogs pa dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzhan dang*/ de la sogs pa ji ltar grub pas mchod par bya'o// 'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyin pa ni bzhi bya bar bshad do// de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ zhes pas/ 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma dang*// phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /ces pas/ phyogs skyong gi gtsang gtor dang*/ gnod sbyin srin pa'i kha zas su// gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas/ bgegs gtor te gtor ma cha gsum dang*/ sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang*/ zhes pas de'i rjes la rigs drug dang*/ yi dwags la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o// cho ga ni/ de'i gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/

zhes pas/ rgyas bsdus gang rung gis kyang btub ste/ 'dir gnas skabs kyi yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas logs shig tu brjod par bya bas na/ der blta bar bya'o// mchod gtor bstan zin to// bcu pa slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ dge bshes gnyal pa na re/ gdong g.yogs yid kyis bcing ba dang*/ phyag rgya bcing ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dam la bzhag pa dang*/ gtso bo la me tog dor ba dang*/ mgo la bcing ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs yid kyis dbye ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang brgyad pos slob dpon bdag 'jug la btub bo zhes zer ro// 'di la jo bo rin chen bzang po la sogs pa gzhan dag na re/ de ni ma yin te/ de dag gi sngon du kun rig nas bshad pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ byin gyis brlab cing smon lam gdab pa dang*/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang bzhi sngon du song nas/ gdod brgyad po la 'jug la/ de nas dam tshig bskyed pa dang*/ brtan par bya ba dang*/ mna' chu blud cing dam bsgrag pa dang*/ sdom pa sbyin pa dang bzhi ste bcu drug po ni/ khrig chags su kun rig nas bshad pas 'jug pa ste/ de tsam ni slob dpon bdag 'jug la cis kyang dgos la/ de nas grub na ni dbang rnams kyang blang dgos te/ mdor na slob ma la ji tsam byed pa tsam rang gis kyang blang dgos te/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la bde bar gshegs pa dam pa sras dang 'bangs su bcas shing*/ 'khor gyis bskor ba rig pa dang lhan cig spyan drang ngo*// de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te/ zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ zhes nga rgyal bskyed la/ slob ma rnams gzhug par bya'o// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas kyang*// de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid kyis// spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par bya// bdag nyid kyis ni dbang bskur la// zhes pa'i rjes la/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid rnams bshad nas// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed la// slob ma dam pa sngags 'di yis// sngags mkhan gyis ni gzud par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// phyogs gnyis po de las/

kho bo 'di'i rjes su 'brang ngo*// de la slob dpon bdag 'jug gi rim pa ni 'di yin te/ de ltar mchod gtor zin nas/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba bzhin byed de/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i chos bcu drug ni/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rgyun bshags dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab cing smon lam gdab pa dang*/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang*/ bsrung ba bya ba dang*/ 'dir gdong g.yogs ni yid kyis bcing ba dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcing ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dam la bzhag pa dang*/ 'dir me tog gtso bo la dor ba dang*/ mgo la bcing ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs yid kyis dbye ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ dam tshig bskyed pa dang*/ dam tshig bstan par bya ba dang*/ dam tshig bsgrag pa dang*/ sdom pa sbyin pa'o// de tsam bya ba'am/ yang spro na dbang rnams rgyas par blangs te/ cho ga thams cad ni slob ma'i skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// de nas tshe dpag med nas bshad pas/ dkyil 'khor la dmigs la/ bzlas pa bag tsam zhig bya/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bcings la rang nyid rigs lnga so so'am/ gtso bo'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal dran pas/ oṃ badzra dha ra/ ratna dha ra/ padma dha ra/ bi shwa dha ra/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ mā ti kra ma ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ dha ra ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal dran par byas la/ gdong slob ma'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// slob dpon bdag 'jug bstan zin to// slob dpon gyi khyad par gyi las su bya ba thams cad kyang bstan zin to// da ni cho ga rgyas bsdus thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa slob ma 'jug cing*/ dbang bskur ba brjod par bya'o// de la gnyis/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ gson po yin na/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bos nas/ sems bskyed pa nas brtsams te byas pas btub kyang*/ 'dir tshe 'das la sbyor bas/ 'di la kha cig na re/

rten bskyed la mi dgos te/ gson po bzhin byas pas btub bo// zhes zer la/ jo bo rin chen bzang po'i man ngag gis/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rgyud 'di nyid nas kyang 'byung la/ gtsug dgu'i dang po'i sbyor ba'i skabs nas gsungs pa/ de nas 'od kyi snang ba yis// sems can thams cad ngan song las// sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug nas ni// sngags dang phyag rgyas dral bar bya// zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad pa dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa'i khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i skabs nas/ rnam shes dgug pa bshad pas/ des dpang po byas nas rten bskyed pa la rnam shes dgug pa 'dir/ cis kyang lhag por sbyor bas de bshad par bya'o// de la bzhi/ bgegs sbyang*/ rten bskyed/ rten dgug sdig pa dral ba'o// de la rten bskyed pa dang*/ dgug pa'i rjes la bgegs sbyangs na yang legs la/ sngon la sbyangs kyang nyes pa med de/ de ltar na rten skad cig gis bsams la bgegs sbyang ngo*// dang po ni 'di la kha cig bgegs 'brel zer nas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bgegs kyis tshags byas pa de 'brel bar byed pa yin/ zhes zer ba ni ma yin te/ bgegs kyis rnam shes gang na gnas mi shes pa'i phyir ro// 'o na ci'i phyir byed ce na/ spyir bgegs ni gsum ste/ dri za 'chi ka ma'i yid la nye bar rgyug pa/ zhes bya ba 'chi kar de'i drung du bsnyen te tshe 'das pa'i gzugs gzung nas/ gson po rnams la gnod pa byed pa yod pas/ gson po la phan gdags pa'i phyir tshar bcad pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre zhes bya ba stobs skyes te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha zhes bya ba stobs chung ste/ de tshe 'das de'i gzugs bzung nas gnas pa de 'dre des shin tu 'tshe ste/ gson po dag la'ang gnod pas/ gson po dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la phan gdags pa'i phyir 'dre de tshar gcad de/ de gnyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba/

lung bstan pa'i mdo nas bshad do// gsum pa ni/ tshe 'das pa nyid la'ang bar mdo'am/ skye ba blangs nas kyang rung ste/ las kyi dbang gis bgegs gnod pa'ang srid pas/ de la'ang phan gdags pa'i phyir/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi bar gyis bya ste/ sbyong rgyud 'di nyid kyi tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas bshad pa/ de nas de yi sdig 'joms lus// bgegs dang bral te ci bde bar// mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang*// khams gsum par ni ci bder spyod// ces bshad pas so// des na dgos pa gsum yod pas na/ bgegs tshar bcad do// de'i cho ga ni sngon du byas kyang btub/ sdig pa dral nas byas kyang btub ste/ dang po la zhi bas sbyang ba gtor ma lan gsum sbyin pas sbyang*/ de nas zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ chang bu dang*/ ting lo'i mar me re sbyin zhing*/ khro bo'i sngags bzlas pas sbyang*/ de nas gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ sngar bshad pa'i khro bo'i bstod pa dbyangs dang bcas pa dang*/ khro bo'i sngags mang po zlos shing*/ drag pos sbyang ba yun ci rigs pa bya'o// bgegs sbyang ba'o// de nas gnyis pa rten bskyed pa ni rten ming byang la sogs pa ste/ oṃ sha shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ gis stong par sbyang*/ tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po'am/ nṛ las tshe 'das der bskyed/ de la yid dam gyi lha yod na lhar bskyed kyang btub bo// de nas gsum pa dgug pa ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings la/ bdag gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od dang*/ tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i nṛ'am/ hūm̐ las kyang 'od 'phros te/ khams gsum nas rnam shes dgug par bsam zhing*/ bden pa brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi khro bo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi brlabs kyis/ tshe 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/ khams gsum mam/ skye gnas bzhi gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes lan gsum brjod la/ yang*/ oṃ shodha ne shodha ne sarb+ba pā paṃ a pa ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba srid pa bar ma'am/ 'gro ba rigs drug tu skyes kyang gang na gnas pa nas bkug la/ rten la bstim par bya'o// de nas bzhi pa sdig pa dral ba ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo gnyis mnyam la/ tha ma bzhi rtse sprad pa mnye zhing*/ oṃ sarb+ba bita sarb+ba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarb+ba bi ta tra tha/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bi spho ṭa ya/ sarb+ba a pā ya bandha ni pra mo kṣa ya/ sarb+ba a pā ya ga te bhyaḥ sarb+ba sa twā na sarb+ba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes bya bas sdig pa sbyangs la/ rdo rje bsdams pa dral zhing*/ oṃ badzra bandha tra tha/ zhes pas sdig pa dral nas/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis spyi bo la sogs par gtug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bid badzra a dhi tiṣṭhā na dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya bas/ rnam par shes pa a dri ma med pa dkar por bsams la byin gyis brlab bo// de rnams ni dbang dang phyir bzlog pa la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba thams cad la yang dgos pa yin no// 'di ni kho bos rigs par yang mthong ngo*// de nas bar 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba'i bye mas brab cing*/ bzlas pa dang*/ bum chus bkru ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro ste/ phyir bzlog gis sbyangs nas dbang bskur ba bya ba'am/ rten bskyed pa'i rjes de nyid la dbang bskur ba gang rung bya'o// sngon la lag len ni/ rten bskyed nas bzlas pa dang*/ phyir bzlog gis sbyangs nas/ gdod dbang bskur byed la/ 'dir kun rig gi gzhung ma 'khrugs par byed na sngon la 'jug pa dang*/

dbang brjod par bya'o// de ltar bskyed pa'i rjes la 'jug pa dngos ni/ sdig sbyong gi rten nyid la rjes zlos la sogs pa bdag gis brjod cing*/ des byed par yid kyis bsams la/ me tog dang gdong g.yogs bya ba yid kyis bsam pa'am/ rjes zlos dag gdong g.yogs dang*/ me tog dor ba rnams/ de'i bu la sogs pa'i 'brel ba byed du bcug pa gang yang rung ba la 'gal ba med do// de la 'jug pa la chos bcu bdun te/ sems bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyun bshags bya ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ smon lam gdab pa dang*/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang*/ bsrung ba bya ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs bcing ba dang*/ phyag rgya bcings nas 'jug pa dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dam la bzhag pa dang*/ me tog dor ba dang*/ mgo la bcing ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs dbye ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ dam tshig bskyed pa dang*/ dam tshig brtan par bya ba dang*/ dam tshig bsgrag pa dang*/ sdom pa sbyin pa'o// dang po sems bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyun bshags ni/ rdo rje 'byung ba bzhin mdzad de/ dngos su rjes zlos byed pa'am/ byed par bsam zhing*/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*// rjes su yi rang yang na bgyis stsal gang*// de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni// spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags// bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*// rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don// sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang*// rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing*// blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom// ma lus rigs kyi padma'i nang zhugs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su 'chi// blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste// dman pas 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal// srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing*// blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje cher ldan pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*// srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyu yi rjes su bdag po'i yul bdag nyid// 'bras bu'i stobs kyi dgra las rgyal gyur pa'i// snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs// mnyam med byang chub sems ni gzung bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am// yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram// rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir// 'di dag thams cad rtsa sogs bzhin du gtang*// de bzhin tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa 'di// bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir// skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom bar bgyi// bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yis// chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni// 'gro ba 'di yi thob par bya ba'i phyir// khyad 'phags gnas la bdag gis gnas par bgyi// zhes bya ba dang*/

sa ma ya a zhes brjod de/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po bsams la/ dngos su reg cing*/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes bzlas te/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems so// de nas tshe 'das des sngar dbang thob cing*/ lha sgom shes pa yin na/ bu la sogs pa ma yengs par yid kyis/ de nyid rjes su zlo bar byed par bsgom zhing*/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa yang dbog par bya'o// da ni rgyud las/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub bar// de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug /ces bya ba'i don dang po yin no// da ni rgyud las/ de nas byin rlabs byang chub smon lam gdab/ ces pa'i don/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar bstan pa bzhin/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ yang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dang*/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭhā dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya bas/ snying ga lkog kha phyogs su// dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// nyi shu rtsa gnyis su byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de ltar ma nus na/ rang gi lha'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ yi dam gyi lhar bsam mo// gsum pa byang chub kyi don du smon lam gdab pa ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig ces bya ba la sogs pa'i smon lam gdab par bya'o// rgyud las/ zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ zhes pas/ bzhi pa chos zab mo bshad pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang nas 'byung ba bzhin du/ 'di skad ces brjod pa mnyan du gzhug ste/ 'jig rten du na kun mkhyen dag

/u dum bā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa'i mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dongs pas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes bya ba'am/ yang na/ zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba ston pa'i chos tshigs bcad dam/ tshig lhug pa gang yang rung ba cig bshad la/ theg chen rdo rje theg pa la shin tu spro ba bskyed par bya'o// bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ zhes pas/ lnga pa bsrung ba ni/ gong du brjod pa bzhin/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgyas lan gsum du bsrung ba bya/ de nas dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs zhes pas/ drug pa gdong g.yogs rten la dngos sam yid kyis bcing ngo*// bdun pa phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭhā hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/

rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo mnyam pas me tog bzung la/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o// de nas brgyad pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pas/ de'i lus la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra pra be shā ya hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa cig brjod par bya'o// dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ ye shes kyi dam tshig brtan par bsam mo// bcu pa me tog dor ba ni/ yid kyis gtso bo la dbul ba'am/ bu la sogs pas 'bul du gzhug pa ste/ ngag tu brjod pa/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni// 'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis// sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ badzra pra ti grihna hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog dor bar bya'o// bcu gcig pa ni/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra sa ma ya stāṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me tog slob ma'i mgo la dngos sam/ yid kyis bcing bar bya'o// bcu gnyis pa/ oṃ badzra ha sya udgha ṭā ya hūm̐/ zhes bya bas gdong g.yogs dgrol lo// bcu gsum pa/ oṃ badzra pa shya hoḥzhes bya bas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya'o// bcu bzhi pa/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ dam tshig thams cad rgyud la gnas par bskyed par bya'o// bco lnga pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar bzhag ste/ kun rig snying gar brtan par bsams la/ oṃ badzra sa ma yaṃ hṛ da ya me pra be sha dṛ ḍho tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas/ dam tshig brtan par bya'o// bcu drug pa dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ rnam rgyal gyi bum chu dngos sam yid kyis sbyin zhing*/ rang gi yid la dran pa tsam gyis gsang ste/ 'di brjod par bya ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub// ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni// de ma thag tu bkas nas gshags// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang*// bdun rgyud rigs ni rlag par byed// de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang*// sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'// shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya// zhes brjod par bya'o// bcu bdun pa sdom pa sbyin pa ni/

'di skad ces brjod la nyan du gzhug par bya ste/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang blang mi bya// brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams// dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min// chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang*// dus kun tu ni byang chub sems// snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// lha dang bla ma de bzhin no// sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang*// bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang*// de yi grib ma 'gom mi bya// phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no// sngags dang lha la smad mi bya// gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min// mu stegs can la smad mi bya// mdor na yid gnyis the tshom som nyi mi bya ste// bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no// zhes kun rig nas 'byung ba rnams brjod do// spros pa la dga' na/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas 'byung ba'i sdom pa blang ba rnams kyang brjod par bya'o// 'jug pa bstan zin to// //da ni dbang bskur ba brjod par bya ste/ de'ang rgyud las/ mos pa brtan dang bcas pas dam bcas nas// sarb+ba bid kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te// zhes pas na/ slob ma tshe ldan yin zhing sdom pa dang dam tshig len pa la ni/ dbang rnams bskur la/ dam bca' mi len na sdom pa mi 'bogs par 'jug pa rkyang pa tsam byas la yon blangs la/ smon lam rgyas par btab la gtang ngo*// tshe 'das la ni/ thams cad rdzogs par byed do// de ni 'di ltar bya ste/ spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pas rtsa rig gi rjes la/ oṃ sarb+ba bita sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarb+ba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarb+ba bita phaṭa/ oṃ sarb+ba bid aḥ oṃ sarb+ba bi ta tra tha/ oṃ sarb+ba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarb+ba bita swa/ oṃ sarb+ba bid aḥ

oṃ sarb+ba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarb+ba bita tra tha/ oṃ sha/ oṃ bha/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dbang bskur te/ sarba bita kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te/ zhes gsungs so// de nas bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs nas// bcu po rnams kyis dbang bcu ci dgar bskur// de nas lag tu rdo rje dril bu sbyin// 'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la// mi dbang dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa dang*// sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya// zhes 'byung bas/ bum pa dngos su smos pa yin la/ de'i rjes la sogs kyis bsdus pa/ dbang bcu ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rigs lnga'i cod paṇa dang*/ rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ dar gyi cod paṇa dang*/ phyag rgya lnga'i dang*/ ming dang*/ phrin las dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bdag po dang*/ gzungs dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang gi bar bcu'o// yang na bum pa la sogs te/ dar dang*/ rin po che'i cod paṇa gnyis gcig tu byas te bcu'o// thabs shes bar ni rdo rje dril bu sbyin no// de nas rin po che sna bdun te/ so sor phye na/ dbang bcu dgu bskur bar bya'o// de la dbang bcu dgu/ rgyud ji lta ba bzhin bsdus te bskur ba dang*/ rgyas par bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ dngos su'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bskur zhing*/ oṃ badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ de nas gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya 'ching zhing*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bcing ngo*// oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ de nas phreng ba 'dogs pa ltar byas la/ rin po che'i phreng ba bcing bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ ratna mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ dar gyi cod paṇa 'ching ba'i tshul du bya zhing der bsams la/ oṃ badzra pa ṭā pa laṃ pa na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ buddha mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ratna mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ rigs lnga'i ming 'dogs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra nā ma i bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ ratna nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ zhes pas/ ming gi dbang ngo*// sna tshogs rdo rje byin par bsams la/ oṃ badzra karm+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥ chos kyi 'khor lo lag tu byin par bsams la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub nus pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la sprul pa dang*/ bshad pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad bskor nus par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ zhes brjod do// rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje slob dpon byed nus par bsams la/ oṃ badzra tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ buddha tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ ratna tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ oṃ padma tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrīḥhrī/ oṃ karm+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes brjod do// dbang de dag thams cad dran pa dang*/ shes rab kyis mi rjed par gyis shig ces bsams pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya/ spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces kyang bsams te/ oṃ badzra dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/

oṃ ratna dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ sngar gyi dbang rnams dam tshig ma thob pa la gsang bar gdams shing*/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ratna gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ padma gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ de nas rdo rje dril bu byin la/ thabs dang shes rab stong pa dang*/ snying rje chen po mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces bsams la/ oṃ pra dzñā u pa ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥzhes brjod do// de nas shog bu la byas pa'i gzugs lag tu gtad pa'am/ ma gtad kyang rung ste lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun de'i lag tu byin par bsam zhing*/ sngar mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ wa ti ni ratna a hi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ma hā ta ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ hasti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ tu ram̐ ga a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ khaḍga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang bcu dgu bskur bar bya'o// dbang bcu dgu pa de dag la spros pa la dga' bas/ rgyas par byed par spro na/ dbang rdzas dang*/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pas bskur bar bya ste/ bum pa thogs nas ming byang la sogs pa bkru zhing*/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa kun dag ste// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /oṃ buddha ka la sha zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar gyi sngags lnga brjod par bya'o// de nas rigs lnga bris pa'i dbu rgyan lag tu thogs la/

rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas/ rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rtogs shing*/ thob pa'i dbang dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod paṇa 'dis/ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lnga brjod par bya zhing dbu rgyan bskon no// rin po che'i phreng ba'am rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa thogs la/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la rin po che'i phreng bas dbang bskur bas/ bsam pa mya ngan las 'das kyang*/ sbyor ba khams gsum na 'gro ba'i don byed pa la/ mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog phreng ba 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// bsam pa myang 'das sbyor ba khams gsum gnas// mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cig /oṃ ratna mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ zhes dbu rgyan nam/ phreng ba bcing ngo*// de nas dar gyi cod paṇa bcings la/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la/ dar gyi cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa la mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig mdzes shing yid 'ong dar gyi cod paṇa gyis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang dbang thob shog /oṃ badzra pa ṭa laṃ pa na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ de nas shing bu la sogs pa las byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje byas la sbyin zhing*/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la/

rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par gyur cig rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// ye shes lnga ni rab tu rtogs par shog /oṃ buddha mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la/ ming gi dbang bskur bas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nges pa can rtogs shing thob pa'i dbang dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshan ma ming gi dbang*// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ma 'ongs 'jig rten sangs rgyas zhing khams su// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /oṃ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o// sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin zhing*/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la/ las rnam bzhi'i dbang bskur bas/ phrin las bzhis bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed pa la mthu thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mthar phyin te// las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ badzra karm+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la 'khor lo lag tu byin nas/ slob dpon du dbang bskur bas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thob ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste// chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor bar shog /oṃ badzra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu spyi bor reg cing*/

khyod la bdag po'i dbang bskur bas/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig rigs lnga bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por shog /oṃ badzra tsakra a dhi pa ti stāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lnga brjod do// shog bu gcig la/ rdo rje dang*/ chos 'byung dang*/ padma dang*/ spyan dang*/ utpa la bris pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la yum lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ gsang rgyud mtha' dag 'chad cing shes pa dang*/ gzhan la 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig yum lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas su// 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ badzra dhā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lnga brjod do// rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ slob ma khyod la rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas spyi bo'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ thugs gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i thugs gsang ba'i byang chub kyi sems rtogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar bcings nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te// byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lnga brjod par bya'o// de ltar dbang bcu rdzogs nas thabs shes rab kyi dbang bskur te/ rdo rje dril bu byin la/ khyod la rdo rje dril bu byin te dbang bskur bas/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel bas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don spyod pa dang ldan par gyur cig

de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis// nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin// khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// oṃ pradzñā u pa ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥ de nas 'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la/ zhes bya ba'i don ni/ shing bu'am/ shog bu la rin po che sna bdun gyi gzugs byas pa lag tu thogs la dbang bskur te/ 'khor lo thogs la/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu zlum// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ dus gsum rgyal bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo 'di// mi khom rgyun gcod rgyu dang 'bras bu ston// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug rin po che// bla med 'khor lo dam pa bskor gyur cig /bdud thams cad las rgyal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par bskor bar gyur cig rin po che lag tu 'dzin pas/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas bai ḍūrya// kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*// dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin// nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan rin po che// 'khor ba'i mun sel bde ba'i snying po 'byung*// dgos pa mchog sbyin nor bdun phun sum tshogs// yid bzhin nor bu rin chen spyod par shog /tshe dpag tu med pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rang gi gzi brjid kyis zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig btsun mo 'dzin pas brjod pa/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ba// pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan// yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i rig bya dang ldan pa'i// btsun mo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ wa ti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/

pha rol phyin bcus sems can skyob pa'i phyir// shes rab gzugs 'dzin btsun mo rin po che// bsdu ba rnam bzhi tshad med bzhi po yi// tshe dang longs spyod gter la spyod par shog /sems can thams cad la ting nge 'dzin zhi ba'i tshul gyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don bde bar sgrub pa la yid bzhin du 'byor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig blon po 'dzin pas brjod pa/ gang yang rgyal ba mu tig mdangs ldan pas// gser sogs mang po thugs la phul ba ltar// bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan te// blon po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ mahā ta ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ gang la ci dgos dpag bsam shing lta bus// 'gro la snying brtses tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ dbang phyug btsun pa blun po rin po che// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs thob par shog /lha'i mig rnam par dag pa thob ste 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan zhing*/ rang dang gzhan gyi dgos pa mthar phyin nas/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig glang po 'dzin pas brjod pa/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni// rab gnas ri 'dra gangs chen glang po che// rgyal ba la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i// glang po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ hasti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ theg pa don dam bla med ston pa'i mchog /yan lag bdun mdzes ku mu ta yi mdog gdul dka' stobs chen glang po rin po che// khyu mchog rlabs chen stobs lnga rdzogs par shog /stobs bcu dang ldan zhing*/ bdud bzhi'i stobs tshar bcad nas/ sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la 'dzud nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig rta mchog rin chen thogs te/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i// sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog 'gyur ba// rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i// rta mchog rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/

'khor ba'i chu bo 'jigs pa bzhi las sgrol// brtson 'grus myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis bskyod// cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rin po che// mi gnas ye shes yid bzhin spyod par shog /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis/ 'gro ba rnams mi gnas pa'i dbyings su thogs pa med par skyel nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig dmag mi rin po che lag tu bzung la/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong gyur pa'i// ma lus bdud dpung 'jigs par byed pa ste// dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi// dmag mi rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ khaḍga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ gnod pa'i dpung 'joms brtson 'grus go bgos shing*// 'jigs pa'i skyob byed 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin// thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dmag dpon 'dis// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung gis bsrung bar shog /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin nas/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo chen po 'joms shing*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /ces brjod par bya'o// de ltar dbang rgyas pa de dag ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga na bzhugs so// zhes rin chen bzang po'i gsung gi brgyud pa las thos so// de ltar dbang de dag dgos pa gang gi don du bskur zhe na/ sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ zhes so// de'i rjes la/ sngags sgrub phyir ni mos ldan slob ma la// sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya// zhes 'byung bas/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*// 'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*// sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na// lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos// sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam// rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni// rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur bas// slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya// rdo rje spun dang srin mo dang*// rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni// rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya// rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste// bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*// dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang*// de sogs byed pa tshar gcod na// 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung*// sems can kun la snying brtses chags// bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes bdag nyid kyis brjod la/

de'i rgyud la skyes par bsam mo// des kyang ci 'byor pa'i yon bla ma la dbul bar bya'o// de dag ni kun rig nas/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni// zhes bya ba nas/ snying rje can gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes bya ba'i bar tshigs bcad lngas ro yod kyang rung*/ rus bu la sogs pa'am/ tha na ming gi bar la dbang bskur te/ sdig pa sbyang ba bstan zin to// de tsam gyis rdzogs par byed na yang*/ 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mjug gi bya ba rnams rdzogs par bya'o// dbang dang 'brel ba'i sdig pa sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur te/ mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni// sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur// lha yi gzugs su brtags nas kyang*// mchod rten dbus su gzhag par bya// zhes bya ba'i don ni/ rten ro yod pa la sbyong bar mi 'dod pa'am/ ro med kyang sātstsha 'debs par mi 'dod pa'i dbang du bya ste/ snga ma bzhin du dbang thams cad bskur la/ sngar gyi las khyad par du rten te lha dpa' bo gcig pa'am/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed nas/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas mchod pas mchod de/ mchod rten gyi dbus su gzhag par bya'o// lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no// mchod rten du bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba'o// dbang dang 'brel ba'i sdig pa sbyang ba/ gsum pa dri'i gtsang khang du bzhag pa ni/ rang gi lha'am lha gzhan gyis// snying po snying gar bris nas kyang*// lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed nas// khyim gyi nang du gzhag par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ ro yod pa'am/ med kyang gzugs bris pa ni cis kyang dgos te/ de sbyong ba dang*/ mchod rten du 'jog pa dang*/ sātstsha byed par yang mi 'dod cing*/ rang gi khyim du 'jog par 'dod pa'i dbang du byas te/ de'ang sngar bzhin dbang bskur la/ khyad par du rgyud 'di dang*/

rgyud gzhan nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags mang po/ gser ram/ dngul lam/ gur gum gyis bris pa de'i snying gar btags te/ rten de gos sam/ dri la sogs pas brgyan te/ de lhar bskyed/ ye shes pa bkug nas/ ji ltar grub pas mchod nas bstod de/ rang gi khyim gyi phyogs gcig dben pa gtsang zhing dris byugs par bzhag la/ dus nar mar lhar bskyed pa'i rten de la mchod stod byed cing bzhag go /lhag ma thams cad ni sngar bzhin no// don dang po dbang bskur te/ sdig pa sbyang ba bstan zin to// //de nas rgyud nas/ sātstsha'i cho ga tshigs bcad phyed dang gsum yod pa ni/ 'dir mi 'jug ste/ 'og ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba'i skabs rjes nas rgyas par bshad cing der 'jug pas der brjod par bya'o// //'dir spyi don gnyis pa bzlas pa bya bas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni// ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags bzlas shing*// 'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni// brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang*// bye ba snyed du rab bzlas na// lha yi gnas su nges par skye// zhes 'byung ba'i don ni/ dbang bskur dang 'brel na ni/ 'di phyir bzlog dang dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'am/ yang na thun mtshams su ci rigs par 'jug pa yin la/ dbang dang ma 'brel na ni/ 'di dngos gzhi yin la/ gang gi phyogs la yang 'gal ba ni med do// cho ga gzhan thams cad ni/ rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba snga ma bzhin nyams su blangs la/ bdag gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i snying gar zla ba la mtha' skor du rtsa rig nang du gtso bo gang yin gyi sngags bkod la/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas bshad pa bzhin/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das pas gtso byas nas/ ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang*/ byol song dang*/ yi dwags su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad grol bar bdag nyid kyis rab tu shes so// 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/

snang bar byas nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi chos kyi yi ge de nyid du zhugs par gyur to// zhes bsam zhing*/ rgyud nas 'byung ba'i sngags thams cad dang*/ gtso bor rtsa ba'i rig pa bzla bar bya'o// bzlas pas sdig pa sbyang ba bstan zin to// //de nas spyi don gsum pa phyir bzlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rgyud nas 'khrugs kyi tshul du/ ro sreg dang*/ sātstsha'i rjes la 'byung ba de/ don gyis 'dir 'jug pas de bshad pa/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs// rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas// bzlas pa byas te gtor nas kyang*// rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dor// de ltar byas na sdig can yang*// ngan song las ni thar 'gyur zhes// bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs// zhes bya ba'i bar phan yon rgyas par gsungs so// de'i mngon par rtogs pa ni bsdus te byed na/ bsnyen pa nas mchod gtor gyi bar dang*/ rten bskyed pa'i bar rgyas bsdus gang byed pa snga ma bzhin nyams su blangs la/ rten de la bye ma'am/ yungs kar thogs pas/ rgyud nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags zlos shing brabs nas nub gcig tu byed/ rdzogs pa'i mjug tu bye ma la sogs pa'i dman ma rnams rgya mtsho la 'bab pa'i chu bor dor bar bya'o// rgyud na ni de nyid bzhugs so// jo bo rin chen bzang po'i phyag len rgyas par brjod na/ ya tha bsnyen pa nas bzung ste/ ma tha mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar rnams rgyas bsdus gang byed pa snga ma bzhin byas la/ de nas rten la bya ba'i cho ga ni/ bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa dgug pa dang*/ sdig pa dral ba dang bzhi/ snga ma bzhin byas la/ yang bgegs zhi bar bya ba spros pa'i bye brag gis rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig 'dir yang bya ste/ de dag zhi bas sbyang ba ni sngar byas la 'dir drag pos sbyang ba byas na mdzes so// de nas brdeg pa ni/

rgyud 'di nyid nas kyang gsungs la/ gtsug dgu nas kyang*/ yungs kar me tog dang ldan pas// gsang sngags bzlas shing brdeg par bya// zhes 'byung bas/ bye ma'am/ yungs kar gyis rten de la brab cing*/ rtsa ba'i rig pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags ji tsam nus pa bzlas pa'i rjes la/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i brdeg sngags brjod cing brab ste/ oṃ sarb+ba pā paṃ da ha na badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarb+ba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarb+ba karm+ma ā ba ra ṇā ni bha smiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni bi spho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhri ta bhri ta sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshindha tshindha sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarb+ba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarb+ba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang rig sngags mthu dang gzi brjid chen po gzhan yang bzlas shing rten la brab bo// de nas khrus bya ste/ rgyud nas kyang*/ dbang gi sngon du bya bar bshad pa/ de nas khrus la sogs byas la/ dri dang phreng sogs phreng ba can// zhes bya ba dang*/ bum pa'i dbang gis kyang bkru bar bshad pa dang*/ gtsug dgu nas kyang*/ rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni// rdo rje chu yis bkru bar bya// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs la/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis// dus gsum du ni khrus bya'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas na/ bkru ba ni rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la sogs pa gang grub bshams pa la/

sngar bzlas pa byas pa'i bum pa'i chus/ 'dir lugs ma'am/ ras bris dang*/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa la me long bstan pa la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bkrus la/ de slar bum par blug go /de nas bum pa thogs la/ nub gong ma rnams la ni/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/ nub tha ma la ni/ ming byang la sogs pa'i rten la dngos su bkru zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba'i dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarb+ba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarb+ba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karm+ma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing bkru'o// de bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa re re'i mjug tu sngags bzlas shing bkru ste/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// zhe sdang dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bzod pa 'dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// dri chu drug gis khrus byas shing*// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes bya ba tshigs bcad re re dang sngags re spel zhing bkru'o// bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad cing shes pa yang brjod cing bkru ste// tshigs bcad ni logs shig tu brjod par bya'o// yang nyon mongs pa'i dug dang*/

nyon mongs pa las skyes pa 'byung ba'i dug sbyang zhing sngags dang bcas pas bkru ste/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan du mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo// sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// chu ni dug gi pha yin te// chu ni dug gi ma yang yin// me ni dug gi pha yin te// me ni dug gi ma yang yin// rlung ni dug gi pha yin te// rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis// dug ni 'byung ba'i nang du songs// zhes bya bas kyang bkru'o// de nas bu la sogs pa'i lag tu byang bu 'dzin pas phyag byed du bcug la yid kyis tshe 'das des byed cing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba rnams ngag tu zlos pas skyabs su 'gro ba byed par bsam zhing*/ bdag gis dbyangs dang bcas te brjod pa/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa rnams sel ba// tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so// de yis thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes sems thag pa nas/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ nye ba'i sras brgyad la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas rgyas par byed na/ 'dir gong du bstan pa bzhin sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ 'jug pa thams cad dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa nas bzung ste/ dbang bcu dgu po thams cad 'dir byed de/ 'di ni rgyud nas shin tu bsod nams che bar bshad pas na/ ci 'grub par bya ste/ 'jug pa ci grub pa dang*/ dbang ngam 'jug pa ma grub kyang*/ dbang tsam grub kyang bzang ste 'dir bya'o// 'di ni legs par bris pa'o// de dag gi rjes la/ tshe 'das de yi dam gyi lha bsams la/ de la mchod pa ci 'byor dang*/ me tog gi char dbab pa la sogs bya'o// de nas lam sbyang ba dang*/ bstan pa bya'o// gong gi mchod pa'i skabs der/ yul kha cig na/ nub tha ma la gos lham gtad pa bya ba'i lag len byed pa'i yul dag yod de/ de byed na tshe 'das lhar bsams pa de la 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas gos dang lham dang*/ zan dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa dbul lo// yang yul kha cig na/ nub tha ma la byang bu bsreg pa'i cho ga la mos pa yod pas/ de byed na/ cho ga logs su brjod par bya ste/ rgyud 'di na med pa'i phyir ro// lam sbyang ba dang*/ bstan pa ni/ 'di'i cho ga gtsug dgu na yod pas byed de/ de'i sngags ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs na yod pas de byed na/ nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes la byed la/ nub tha ma la ni/ byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la byed do// de ni thams cad kyis me tog gi char dbab cing 'di skad ces brjod de/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog

/oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne ratne saṃ bha wa ratna ki ratne/ ratna mā la bi shu ddhe/ sho dha ya/ sarb+ba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra tha/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos par// srid pa'i padma las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ padme padme padma saṃ bha ba/ su kha ba tī gatstshantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ro// de nas tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes par bsam zhing*/ bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' sngar skyes pa'i rnying pa rnams kyis/ de la mchod par bsam/ des kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod nas/ der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gi mthu yin par shes te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed cing*/ ched du rjod pa byed par bsam ste/ e ma'o sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod cing bdag la mchod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod cing*/ slar bde ba can du song bar bsam zhing mchod pa lnga tsam gyis mchod la me tog gtor ro// de nas gtor ma dang mdo dag sngon du song bas/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas par gdab par bya'o// yon bdag la dge ba'i bkra shis la sogs pa brjod nas/ yon bdag gis kyang*/ mchod ston dang*/ yon rgya che ba dbul zhing smon lam rgyas par gdab par bya'o// phyir bzlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba bstan zin to// //bzhi pa sbyin sreg gis sdig pa sbyang ba la sogs pa tshe 'das pa'i don bya ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ kun rig nas tshigs su bcad pa brgyad dang*/ tshe dpag med nas tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum gyis/ tshe 'das kyi las gtso bor bstan cing*/ tshe ldan la zhar la sbyar ba bstan la/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ me ltar 'bar ba gnyis nas tshe ldan gyi bya ba bstan te/

cho ga ni khyad par med do// de la bzhi ste/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po'o// de dag kyang dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na ni/ phyogs shar du zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ lho ru drag po'i thab rnams brtsigs la/ sgrub pa po'i kha yang zhi ba la shar du ste/ de bzhin du de dag gi phyogs su blta'o// dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu zhi ba'i thab byas la/ kha shar du blta/ de bzhin du sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor la phyogs te blta bas lhor rgyas pa la kha byang du blta/ shar du dbang la kha nub tu/ byang du drag po'i thab byas la/ kha lhor blta'o// de la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni gtso bo yin la/ lhag ma gsum ni ci grub pa nyams su blang ngo*// de'ang zhi ba'i rtogs na/ 'og ma gsum zhar la rtogs par 'gyur ro// de la dgu ste/ thab bca' ba dang*/ bud shing bsham pa dang*/ mchod pa la sogs pa dang*/ rgyan dgram pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas dang*/ sgrub pa po'i yan lag dang*/ me sbar ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dang*/ 'das pa'i lha rnams spyan drang zhing*/ mchod bstod la sogs bya ba dang*/ mjug gi bya ba dang*/ phan yon no// dang po ni/ tshe dpag med nas 'byung ba// mdor na thig ni btab nas kyang*// cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya// de ni mthong ba brgyud las shes so// lha yi bu rnams zhi ba yi// hom khung tha ma bar ma mchog /khru gang khru do khru bzhi pa'i// zlum po nyid du byas nas ni// de ni dbyibs so// de'i dbus su 'khor lo ni// rtsibs brgyad 'od zer dkar po bri// de nas ro sreg gi skabs nas 'byung ba/ lte bar rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug bri/ de nas sor bzhi bskyed pa la/ khor yug rdo rje rtse lnga pa// 'od zer dkar dang ldan par bri// yar la sor bzhi brtsigs pa la// de nas rdo rje rgya gram dang*// de nas sor gnyis smad pa dang yang sor gnyis smad pa la/

rdo rje rin chen chu skyes mchog /de yi phyi rol lha snam la// de nas sdig pa gzhom pa'i phyir// phyag rgya sna tshogs gzhag par bya// zhes pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal ba rnams kyi mtshan ma bri/ sgo bzhir/ phyi yi rdo rje'i rigs rnams ni// phyag rgya rnams ni phyi rim bri// de nas sgo bya ba'am/ yang na zlum po'i khor yug nyid la/ gza' dang skar ma'i mtshan ma dang*// de ltar 'jig rten skyong ba rnams// zhes pas bstan te/ khor yug la lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' brgyad/ phyogs skyong bcu/ 'jigs byed brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams ming ngam/ brda'am/ thig le bri'o// de nas me ltar 'bar ba nas// bud shing zho dang ldan pa la// dri chus bskus pa shes par bya// zhes te/ bud shing mdzes par bsham par bya'o// de nas rgyan dgram pa ni/ gtso bo ri mo lugs ma ru// rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /bya dang bum pa gang ba dang*// gtor ma lha bshos rab bkang bzhag /ces pa dang*/ me ltar 'bar ba nas kyang*/ bdug spos mar me me tog rnams kyang bzhag /mchod par bya ba'i phyir ni bla re dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnga yab la sogs bzhag /nang rer ga pur bcas pa'i dri zhim dang*// tsandan la sogs pa yi byug pas byug /ces pas rgyan dgram pa'o// bsreg rdzas ni/ kun rig nas/ til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams dang*// ra yi 'o ma ldan pa dang*// dri yis bskus pa'i yam shing gis// cho ga bzhin du sbyin sreg bya// zhes pa dang*/ tshe dpag med nyid nas/ de yi ming dang yungs kar gyis// brgya phrag stong du bsregs byas nas// ngan song kun las thar bar 'gyur// de yi sha dang rus pa dang*// skra dang thal ba la sogs pas// cho ga de dang 'dra bar ni// sbyin sreg byas na ngan song yang*// kun las rnam par thar par 'gyur// mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi can// 'bras yos yungs kar bsres pa dang*// de yi rus pa sha la sogs// med na ming nas smos te bya// zhes pas bsreg rdzas bstan to// de nas sgrub po'i yan lag ni// dkar po'i gos ni gyon nas kyang*// sangs rgyas gzugs can mi 'jigs pas// ngan song rgyud la gnas pa yi// sems can rjes su dran byed cing*// zhes bya ba dang*/

'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ me ltar 'bar ba nas kyang bstan pa bzhin te/ rgyan la sogs pa dkar por byas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rdo rje skyil krung ngam/ sems dpa'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o// de nas me sbar ba ni/ yam shing gis me sbar te/ me ltar 'bar ba nas/ 'dab bdun me tog 'bras bu rnams// zho dang ldan pa'i yam shing gis// me sbar thab khung khyad par las// rang gi sor gyis gzhal bya zhing*// nyi shu rtsa brgyad man chad mchog /bcu drug sor ni bar ma ste// tha ma bcu gnyis nyid du shes// shin tu chung ba sor brgyad do// bud shing zho dang ldan pa la// dri chus bskus par shes par bya// bsregs shing de las byung ba'i me// sbar nas dri chus gtor nas ni// zhes bya ba'i don yam shing gis me sbar la/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzla zhing*/ thab dang rdzas thams cad la ku sha'i rtse mos dri'i chus gtor zhing bsangs la/ mchod rdzas thams cad bdud rtsi mchog tu bsam par bya'o// de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das par mchod pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba las/ padma dkar po'i zhal 'dra dge /padma nor bu ril ba thogs// lag na dbyug pa mchog thogs pa// padma dkar po'i gdan stengs 'dug /de lta'i me lha bkug nas kyang*// mchod yon blangs te dbul bar bya// de nas zla ba dkar po la/ bzhugs pa'i 'gro phan spyan drangs te// padma dkar po shar phyogs su// bsams te steng du gzhag par bya// de nas de ltar bsams nas kyang*// bsgrub bya rtag tu mdun bzhag ste// de yi nyes pa drangs nas ni// shin tu bsrings te sbar bar bya// nang par sngar ni gtsang gyur cing*// shin tu dri zhim lus byugs la// bdud rtsi bzhin bsams sbyin sreg bya// dam tshig 'di ni 'da' bar dka'// lha rdzas bdud rtsi ro lnga ni/

dang po me lha brtag byas la// khro bo de ni de lus la// spyan drangs nas ni bzhugs par bsams// de nas dang po khro bo la// bsreg bya lan gsum dbul bar bya// de nas dkon mchog gsum la dbul// de nas me lha nyid la gsum// de nas rdo rje sems dpa' la// de nas lha rnams re re la/ de nas bgegs la sogs la dbul// yid du 'ong ba'i lha yang rung*// de la dang po khro bo yi// sngags kyis yam shing sbyin sreg bya// de nas gcig tu bsres nas kyang*// bdud rtsi'i sngags kyis btab nas ni// de bzhin sbyin sreg byas 'og tu// chig 'bum rnyed dam yang na ni// brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du ni// khro bo nyid la dbul bar bya// zhes bshad do// de dag gi don ni 'di yin te/ sngar bstan pa bzhin du thab khung legs par byas la bud shing mdzes par brtsigs te/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa legs par bshams la/ mar dang til gtso bor gyur pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams mdun du nye bar bshams te/ bdag snga dro'i dus su kha shar du bltas/ gos dang rgyan dkar pos brgyan te/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor bsnyen pa bzhin rdzogs par byas nas/ ci 'byor gyis bdag nyid la mchod la/ yam shing la me sbar te/ oṃ badzra dzwā la dzwā la hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas thab du me sbar la/ ku sha'i chun pos dri zhim pos thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsams la/ thab oṃ shaṃ gis stong par bsam/ oṃ bha zhes brjod pas/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dkar po rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad par bskyed la/ oṃ agna ye dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes bya ba tsam mam/ tshigs bcad la sogs pa rgyas par byas kyang rung ste/ shar lho nas me lha dkar po ra skyes dang padma dkar po'i gdan can/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon padma/ 'og ma gnyis kyis g.yon ril ba dang*/

g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa spyan drangs nas/ thab khung du bzhugs pa la mchod yon zhabs bsil dbul/ me lha'i sbyin sreg 'dir dbul ba'am/ 'og tu 'bul ba gang rung byas te/ gzhung nas 'og tu bya bar bshad do// de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa gong du bshad pa'i tshigs bcad la sogs pas spyan drangs pa thab kyi shar du padma'i steng du/ spyan drangs pa la'ang ci 'byor gyis mchod de/ me lha'i lto ba yangs par spyan drangs la/ de dag gi thugs ka'i 'od dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bsgrub bya'i sdig pa rnams bkug ste me la thim pas sdig pa thams cad bsregs par bsams nas/ bsreg rdzas rnams so sor bya ba'am/ thams cad bsres nas byas kyang btub ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags btab pas thams cad bdud rtsir bsams la/ oṃ agna ye che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas me lha la lan gsum dbul bar bya'o// de nas me lha'i lto ba na bzhugs pa'i khams gsum rnam rgyal la/ oṃ badzra satwa krodha a na lārka ma hā badzra krodha dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra prā ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas sdig pa thams cad zhi ba'am/ bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i don du/ khro bo la lan gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pa cig dbul bar bya'o// de nas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya buddha dharmā saṃ ghe bhyo/ che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas dkon mchog gsum la lan ci rigs pa cig dbul bar bya'o// de nas yang me lha la lan gsum dbul bar bya'o// de nas rig sngags thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo'i lto bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas ci rigs pa cig dbul bar bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar spyan drangs la/

rang rang gi sngags sam/ rtsa ba'i rig pas ci 'byor pa dbul bar bya'o// de nas yang khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal la/ bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir lan mang du dbul bar bya'o// de nas phyogs skyong ba dang*/ bgegs la sogs pa thab kyi phyogs gcig tu bkug la/ rang rang gi sngags kyis ci rigs pa dbul lo// de nas yang rang gi chos skyong ba dpa' mgon po la sogs pa thab kyi phyogs gcig tu bkug la/ rang rang gi sngags kyis ci rigs pa dbul lo// de nas rtsa ba'i rig pas rigs drug kun la ci rigs pa sbyin no// de nas yang me lha nyid la ci rigs pa sbyin par bya'o// mjug gi bya ba ni/ me ltar 'bar ba las/ de yi lus la dbang bskur cing*// mnyam par gzhag pas bsrungs nas kyang*// mjug tu mngon par mchod nas ni// lha rnams thams cad gshegs su gsol// zhes 'byung ste/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ sbyin sreg rdzogs pa dang*/ bsgrub bya la ci rigs pas dbang bskur la/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas la lha thams cad la ci 'byor pas mchod de/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de ltar na sbyin sreg dbang dang 'brel par byed na/ lha bsgrubs nas mchod pa'i skabs su sbyin sreg byas la/ gdod dbang bskur ba dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ phyir bzlog bya ba'am/ mjug tu sbyin sreg byas la/ mjug gi cho ga bya ba gang rung yin no// dgos pa ni kun rig nas/ de yi ming nas brjod nas kyang*// mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni// yang na brgya phrag stong snyed du// sbyin sreg byas par gyur pa ni// dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yi// sdig pa de las thar bar 'gyur// zhes bya ba dang*/ sdig pa byang ba'i rtags kyang*/ yang na hom khung nang du ni// me yi ltas ni ston par 'gyur// dkar po nyid dang g.yas su 'khyil// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// spogs chog ni bdag med bsgom pa'o// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg go

/las 'og ma gsum po la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bag tsam re bshad pas rtogs par 'gyur bas na de brjod par bya'o// de la rgyas pa'i thab kyi khyad par ni/ khru do pa nas brgyad pa'i bar ser po dbus rin po ches mtshan pa gru bzhi pa'o// bud shing dang mchod rdzas thams cad ser po'o// yam shing ni mdzub gang ba nas/ khru bzhi pa'i bar ro// bsreg rdzas ni/ 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ me tog ser po sna tshogs dang*/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang*/ dpal 'bras rnams so// sgrub pa po ni gos dang rgyan ser po dang nyi ma'i gung la kha byang du bltas la rgyas pa'i bsam pas bya'o// spyan drang dang mchod bstod ni/ 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa thams cad ser po rin po che'i rgyan can yin la/ khyad par du mjug tu rnam thos sras la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rnams la mang du mchod la/ bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa thams cad tshim zhing rgyas par byas par bsam mo// dgos pa ni/ de ni bde 'gror skyes nas kyang*// mkhas pas rgyas par bya dgos te// zhes pa dang*/ lus can de yi tshe dang dpal// gzi brjid bde ba'i longs spyod 'phel// zhes bshad do// sngags kyi spel tshig ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no// rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg go/ //dbang gi ni/ de nas phan phyir nges par yang*// dbang du bya ba'i las bya ste// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don ni/ thab kyi khyad par ni/ khru gang ba nas bzhi pa'i bar ci rigs par dmar po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu dbus su padma bris pa'o// 'di la khor yug kyang khyad par du mda' gzhu'o// bud shing dang*/ mchod rdzas thams cad ni dmar po'o// bud shing ni/ zhi ba dang tshad mnyam pa las rgyu dmar po'am/ btsag la sogs pas dmar por bskus pa'o// bsreg rdzas ni padma la sogs te me tog dang 'bras bu dmar po nyid do// dmar po ma yin pa rnams kyang dmar por bskus pa dang*/ mar dang*/ gur gum dang*/

tsandan dmar po dang*/ yungs dmar dang*/ btsag mtshal/ zangs phye/ ske tshe/ lan tshwa/ til/ zhi mtshe/ la phug yungs mar/ khrag dngul chen po rnams yin no// sgrub pa po ni/ gos dang rgyan dmar po dang chags pa'i yid kyis phyi dror kha nub tu bltas nas bya'o// 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i lha rnams dmar por spyan drang zhing mchod par bya'o// phan yon ni/ sbyin sreg byas na lha la sogs// thams cad de yi dbang du 'gyur// zhes so// sngags rnams kyi spel tshig ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no// dbang gi sbyin sreg go/ //drag po ni/ de la gdon rnams gzhom pa'i phyir// mngon spyod kyang ni brtsam bya ste// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don ni/ thab kyi khyad par ni/ khru byed dang gsum pa nas dgu pa'i bar nag po gru gsum pa dbus su rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ rdo rje dbyug pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbyug pa dang lngas brgyan la dgra st+was mtha' ma bskor ba'o// mchod rdzas rnams kyang nag po ste/ sha dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'o// bsreg rdzas ni/ khrag dang*/ dug dang*/ yungs mar dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ yungs dmar ro// sgrub pa po ni/ gos dang*/ rgyan nag po dang*/ bgegs tshar bcad pa'i yid kyis srod dam/ nam gyi gung la kha lhor bltas la bya'o// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams nag po'i rnam par spyan drangs la mchod par bya'o// dgos pa ni/ de nas de yi sdig 'joms lus// bgegs dang bral te ci bde bar// mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang*// khams gsum na ni ci bder spyod// ces bshad do// sngags rnams kyi spel tshig ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// drag po'i sbyin sreg go /de lta bu sbyin sreg rnams tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyi don du'ang bya ba ste/ tshe dpag med de nyid las/

go rim 'di dag nyid kyis ni// tshe ldan rnams la'ang bya ba ste// de nas gang gis phyir byas pa// de yi phyir yang de bzhin 'gyur// gzhan dag kyang ni las rnams kyang*// snga ma ji bzhin de ltar bya// de nas sems can thams cad la'ang*// myur du bde skyid thob par 'gyur// zhes bshad pas so// sbyin sreg gis don bya ba bstan zin to// //da ni spyi don lnga pa ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba kun rig nyid nas 'byung ba de bshad par bya'o// de la don brgyad de/ thab khung bya ba dang*/ rgyan dgram pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas bsham pa dang*/ bud shing brtsig pa dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ ro chas su gzhug pa dang*/ me sbar la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha spyan drangs la mchod pa dang*/ mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni// cho ga bzhin du khung brkos la// rdo rjes mtha' ma bskor ba yi// 'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya// rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams// ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri// de bzhin sems dpa' rnams dang ni// 'jig rten gtso bo la sogs bri// zhes 'byung ba'i don ni 'di yin te/ phyi dro'i dus su mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin thig gdab/ ro nar mor bsreg na khru bzhi pa/ tsog tsog pur bsreg na khru gang pa la shong pas khru phyed mar brus pa'am ma brus kyang rung ste khru gang pa zlum po dpangs ci rigs pa brtsigs la/ de'i kha la rdo rje'i phreng ba bri bar bya/ nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ 'khor lo dkar po/

rdo rje zer ba'ang 'dug phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo'ang zer// rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ mtshams su lha mo bzhi'i mtshan ma bri bar bya'o// de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa la sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan ma dgod/ yang nang le tse dgur byas la lha dgu'i mtshan ma dgod/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa la sems dpa' dgod pa 'dra gsungs/ de'i phyir rol du rgya dang dpangs sor bzhi pa gzhi dkar po la sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu/ de'i phyi rol tu khor yug la rgya dang dpangs sor gnyis pa ljang gu la/ rin po che ser po/ de'i phyi rol tu rgya dang dpangs sor gcig pa ser po la padma dmar po bri/ yang na/ dpangs su ma byas par gzhi mnyam po la bri'o// de'i phyi rol tu lha snam la sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ khro bo rnams bri/ sgo byed na sgo ba rnams bri bar bya'o// de'i phyi rol tu khor yug la 'jig rten pa lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' brgyad/ rgyu skar dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jigs byed brgyad dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams ming ngam/ brda'am/ thig le re bri bar bya'o// de nas gnyis pa rgyan dgram par bya ste/ bya dang bum pa gang ba dang*// gtor mas snod rnams bkang ba dang*// brgyad snyed tsam du bzhag pa'am// yang na bcu drug snyed du bzhag /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba'i bshos// me tog phreng sogs de bzhin te// bla re rgyal mtshan dar la sogs// gdugs mchog rnams kyis legs par brgyan// zhes bya ba'i don ni 'di yin te/ me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ bla re la sogs pa bsham/ gtor ma ni/ gtor ma cha gsum gzhi bdag la gcig rigs drug la gcig yi dwags la gcig ste/ drug ni cis kyang bsham/ de nas ci 'byor pa bsham mo// gsum pa bsreg rdzas bsham pa dang*/

bzhi pa bud shing brtsig pa dang*/ lnga pa bdag gi rnal 'byor rnams ni/ lha yi sbyor bas rab gnas la// ga bur gur gum la sogs pas// mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la// til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams la// dri yi chu yis legs bkang ste// 'bras chan yos dang la du dang*// sbrang rtsi ka ra dang ldan pas// brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas la// yam shing la yang de bzhin te// rang gi sngags kyis btab pa'i shing*// khung bu'i nang du gzhug par bya// zhes 'byung ba'i don ni/ gong du smros pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams ci 'byor legs par sta gon bya'o// de nas bud shing la rtsa ba'i rig pa zlos shing dri zhim po'i chus gtor ba khung bur legs par brtsig sgyed po yang gzugs so// de nas ro'i drung du/ ci 'byor gyi mchod pa bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor las kha tshar ba sngon du song yang rung*/ ma song yang rung ste/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor byas la bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas la ro'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// drug pa ro chas su gzhug pa ni/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang*// chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni// bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya// gos dang rgyan gyis klubs nas kyang*// sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug /me tog phreng la sogs pas mchod// gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du// sngags bris pa ni gdags par bya// snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su// sarba bid kyis byin gyis brlab// dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi// dbang po rnams kyi gnas dang ni// de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags// mchog tu dge ba rnams bzhag go /de nas ngan song sbyang ba'i phyir// stan dang bcas te thab dbus su// bzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin// de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni// btab pa'i gos kyis g.yogs par bya// zhes bya ba bshad pa de dag gi don ni 'di yin te/

bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa dang*/ gtor mas bgegs zhi bas sbyang*/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ bgegs drag pos nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don du/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags lan ci rigs pas bzlas pas/ bgegs bsal lo// bum pa la rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas pa'i chus bkru bar bya'o// rtsa rig bzlas pa'i dris nye bar byug par bya'o// rtsa rig bzlas te/ stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs dang*/ ci rigs pa'i rgyan gyis klubs te mdzes par bya'o// gu gul la sogs pa'i dud pas bdug cing*/ khro bo gang yin pa'i sngags bzla bar byas nas/ ro de nyid lha yin snyam du bsams la ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas mchod de/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis snying ga dang*/ lkog ma dang*/ spyi gtsug dang*/ kha rnams su gtug cing*/ oṃ sarb+ba bid badzra a dhi tiṣṭhā dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la/ nyin mor shog bu la bris te/ sta gon byas pa'i yi ge rnams gnas bco brgyad po rnams su gdags par bya'o// de ni dpral ba'i phyogs mdzod spu ru/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarb+ba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddha sarb+ba karm+ma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddhe swā hā/ zhes bya ba'o// de bzhin du rna ba g.yas pa la/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ oṃ sarb+ba a pā yaṃ/ sarb+ba satwa bhyo hūm̐/ rna ba g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarb+ba a pā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgo bo'i gtsug phud la/ oṃ tra tha/ dpung pa gnyis la hūm̐ gnyis so// sna gong la/ oṃ sarb+ba bid sarb+ba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rkad pa la oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ dpus mo g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarb+ba bid phaṭa/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarb+ba bid aḥ bol gong g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarb+ba bid tā tha/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ long bu g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarb+ba bid swa/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ sna rtser/ oṃ sarb+ba bid hūm̐/ mig g.yas su/ oṃ sarb+ba bid tra tha/
